raw.description:
We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Search & Match to shape and drive our core algorithm, ranking, discovery, and recommendation product strategies. Reporting to the VP of AI & Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross-functional product teams.

Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform’s two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.

About this team

Our mission is to provide the best-in-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.

What you'll do

Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy

  • Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Search & Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
  • Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
  • Resource & ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.

Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Executive Storytelling & Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board-ready presentations for executive leadership.
  • Build Cross-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade-offs.
  • Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.

Drive Operational Excellence & Execution

  • Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery.
  • Systems & Marketplace Metrics: Establish clear performance metrics to measure search precision, recall, candidate-to-job match relevance, search latency, and reciprocal marketplace liquidity.
  • Culture of Experimentation: Oversee rigorous A/B testing and experimentation protocols to continuously refine discovery algorithms for both candidate and recruiter touchpoints.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Mentorship & Talent Pipeline: Coach and develop Product Managers, instilling strong business sense, strategic thinking, user empathy, and executive communication skills.
  • Evolve Product Rituals: Establish operational frameworks, governance rituals, and decision-making standards that foster velocity and transparency across teams.

What you'll need

  • 8–10+ years of experience in product management, with significant experience leading two-sided marketplaces, search engines, recommendation systems, or match platforms.
  • Proven Executive Presence: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities—able to influence executive leadership, translate complex technical topics into business impact, and drive organizational consensus.
  • Strong Business Sense: Deep commercial intuition with the ability to connect algorithmic performance (relevance, precision, candidate conversion) directly to platform health and client retention.
  • Two-Sided Marketplace Expertise: Proven track record of balancing dual stakeholder needs—solving for both B2C consumer discovery and B2B enterprise/recruiter search workflows.
  • Strategic & Resource Allocation Mastery: Experience shaping functional product strategies, managing engineering trade-offs, and maximizing investment ROI without direct P&L management.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Skilled at building trust and alignment across matrixed organizations, including Data Science, Machine Learning, UX, and Commercial teams.
  • People Management Experience: Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and leading product managers to drive team growth and operational excellence.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, quantitative, or business field (or equivalent practical experience).

What's good to have

  • Direct experience presenting strategic roadmaps and performance insights to C-suite executives and board members.
  • Background in recruitment technology, two-sided talent marketplaces, resume indexing systems, or professional networking platforms.
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML search paradigms, Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic matching, or vector search technologies.
  • Experience scaling product rituals and decision frameworks within high-growth software organizations.

Additional Pay Ranges

  • All other locations: $170,000-$200,000
  • SF/NY/Seattle : $190,000-$240,000
  • IL/TX: $180,000-$220,000

Benefits

Outstanding Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Bi-annual bonus
  • 401(k) plan with match
  • Equity in company
  • Flexible spending accounts (health, dependent care)
  • Internet and home office reimbursement

100% Full Health Benefits

  • Life & long-term disability insurance (optional)
  • Mental health support and resources
  • Wellness reimbursement (gym, health apps, etc.)
  • Pet Insurance (optional)

Flexible Time Away

  • Flexible PTO
  • Sick time policy
  • Observed holidays

Eligibility

Eligible Hiring Locations

This position is 100% remote, work from home.

BOLD can hire full-time residents of the following U.S. States & Territories: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington D.C) Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

California Residents: Please see our privacy notice for more info on how we handle your data.

Individual pay is based on location, transferable skills, experience, and other relevant factors. This estimated range is based on the best available market data and factors, all of which are subject to change. This position may also be eligible for a bonus and medical, dental, vision, life, short and long-term disability insurance, 401(k), paid time off, sick leave, and paid holidays, all subject to applicable plan terms.

As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. raw.description:
WE'RE LUMA HEALTH.

Needing healthcare can be hard — getting care shouldn’t be.

We builtLuma Health because we are all patients. We believe it should be easy to see and connect with our doctor. To get the care we need, when we need it.

So, we’ve created solutions to fix this problem. Our technology makes messaging easier, scheduling appointments more efficient, and it modernizes care delivery from beginning to end.


The Role: Sales Development Representative

Drive Luma Health’s growth by engaging clinics and health systems, creating interest, and booking qualified meetings. This is a high-performance, mission-driven SDR role with real impact and clear expectations. (Fully remote, U.S.)

What YOU will do at Luma Health:

  • Prospect & build pipeline: High-volume, multi-channel outreach to decision makers; book discovery meetings.
  • Qualify & consult: Run crisp discovery, map pains to Luma value, handle objections, and secure next steps.
  • Hit the number:Quota is graded on number of performed meetings and pipeline velocity metrics; manage time and funnel to exceed it.
  • Collaborate: Partner with AEs and Marketing on targeted campaigns; share market intel to refine strategy.
  • Operate with rigor: Keep Salesforce spotless; document activity, notes, and next steps.
  • Improve fast: Embrace coaching, iterate your pitch, share what works, and level up weekly.

Who YOU Are:

  • Long History of Being Self-Propelled: Biased for action through your life.
  • Ability to Persevere and Perform: Run crisp discovery, map pains to Luma value, handle objections, and secure next steps.
  • Long History of Over-Achieving: Long history of leading in performance as an individual or a team.

What you bring:

  • Drive & resilience: You pursue goals with urgency and bounce back from “no.”
  • Clear communication: Strong written/verbal skills and confident phone presence.
  • Curiosity & empathy: You ask sharp questions and tailor value to each prospect.
  • Proof of achievement: 1+ year in sales/BDR or standout wins that show you hit big goals outside of sales.
  • Ownership: Organized, self-managed in a remote setting; quick to learn tools (Salesforce, outreach, LI Navigator).
  • Coachability & team play: You seek feedback, act on it, and help teammates win.

Bachelor’s preferred, not required. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

What we offer

  • Impact: Every meeting you set can improve access to care for thousands of patients.
  • Growth: Structured onboarding, ongoing training, and clear paths to AE/leadership.
  • Comp: Competitive base + commission with upside; equity eligibility.
  • Remote-first benefits: Home-office support; Competitive Health Benefits (Luma Health covers 99% of the employee and 85% of the dependent premium costs); Company Equity; Flexible time off; Wellness programs, Inclusive, recognition-rich culture.

Hiring Manager: Kennedy Booker, Director of Sales Development | (214) 927-8579 |

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location and experience, the target annual salary for this position can range as detailed below. Full time offers from Luma also include target bonus + stock options + benefits (including medical, dental, and vision.)

Base Pay Range:

$55,000—$60,000 USD

Ready to grow your career and make healthcare work better? Apply and let’s get patients the care they need—faster.

Luma Health is an Equal Opportunity employer, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds and characteristics.

Come join us if you want to make a difference in health care.

Please note that you will never be asked to submit payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. All emails from Luma Health will come from "@lumahealth.io" email addresses. Any emails from other email addresses are scams. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the scammer and contact the FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. If you'd like to verify the legitimacy of an email you've received from Luma Health recruiting, forward it to .

raw.description:
Who we are

At ConnectCPA, we’re not your traditional accounting firm. We are an online/virtual firm, paperless, and tech-savvy. We are growing rapidly and searching for a team member who meshes with our unique firm culture.

We are a Licensed, Chartered Professional Accounting (CPA) firm that operates with a startup mentality: we experiment, we collaborate, we embrace new technologies, we automate, and we actually like Mondays (most of the time).

We’re big believers in working smart, not just hard. We wear hoodies, not suits. We talk on Slack more than email. And we’re constantly on the lookout for new tools and better ways of doing things. We’ve made growth and innovation a part of our DNA.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check us out on ourWebsite, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

You can see the highlights from our 2023 PH retreatHERE.

Why us?

We’re building a workplace where people can grow, feel heard, and actually enjoy their work. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Fully Remote.You will be working from your home office (who doesn't love that?)
  • Room to grow.Opportunities for career development and annual performance increase.
  • Tiered Quarterly Bonus. Turn your exceptional performance into exceptional rewards.
  • Fully paid for health, dental, and vision benefits. Plus access tovirtual healthcare.
  • Fridays off in July & August(yep, paid!)
  • Paid December holiday shutdown. Rest, recharge, repeat.
  • Equipment Provided.A brand-new laptop and all the gear you need to hit the ground running.
  • Your voice matters.From improving workflows to shaping our culture, everyone has a seat at the table.
  • Supportive, inclusive, and low-ego environment.We value respect, collaboration, and open communication, without unnecessary corporate politics.
  • Comfortable, casual, and professional.We don’t require formalwear; wear what helps you do your best work, while remaining presentable and client-ready when needed.

What is the role?

The role requires the candidate to manage multiple clients simultaneously in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.

The following duties must be handled diligently:

  • Weekly Bookkeeping (mix of accrual and cash basis) for large, more complex clients in various industries
  • Work with various bookkeeping-related software
  • Answering more complex bookkeeping-related support questions from clients through Teamwork
  • Provide in-depth analysis of client files, identify inaccuracies and inconsistencies, notify clients, and resolve issues independently.
  • Ensuring clients’ books are kept up-to-date and are accurate and organized, meeting deliverable deadlines.
  • Preparing month-end reports (Balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, etc.)
  • In-depth review of their clients' month-ends and financial statements (Balance sheet, P&L, aged payables, aged receivables)
  • Managing multiple clients of varying complexities simultaneously in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment
  • Identifying bookkeeping process improvement and automation opportunities
  • Assisting with knowledge sharing with other team members in the department or pod Slack channels

Required Experience

  • An excellent understanding of accrual bookkeeping, payroll, debits and credits, clearing accounts, bank reconciliations, and more
  • An excellent understanding of the ins and outs of how an accounting system works: Invoicing, payables, bookkeeping, tax rates, etc.
  • Prior bookkeeping experience in a fast-paced environment of at least 8 years
  • Working knowledge and experience with Xero and QBO

What you bring to the table:

  • Great communicator.You’re confident, clear, and professional in both writing and conversation. Clients trust you, and teammates love collaborating with you.
  • Organized & efficient.You can juggle multiple clients and tasks without dropping a beat, and you are familiar withtask tracking tools ( i.e. Karbon, Clickup, Monday, Asana, etc.)
  • Self-starter energy.You’re proactive, motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote setting.
  • Tech-savvy.You learn new software quickly and maybe even geek over automations and workflow hacks.
  • Accounting know-how. Bookkeeping, invoicing, payables, tax rates, and more. Experience with tools like Xero, QBO, Hubdoc, and Dext is a big plus.
  • You just get it.You’re sharp, dynamic, and ready to become a key player in a fast-growing firm where your ideas make an impact.
  • Strong internet.At least 6Mbps up/down to keep Zoom running smoothly and work flowing freely.

We are looking for somebody talented and dynamic. We are a growing firm, and the individual who is selected for this position will become a key member of our team!

ConnectCPA is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran status or any other protected class.

Description

Join Us at TailorMed – Transforming Healthcare Affordability

Awarded Best in Class in Health Equity 2025

At TailorMed, we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.

TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. Through a connected network spanning 945+ hospitals, 4,700+ clinics, 3,100+ pharmacies, 100+ life sciences programs, and 6,000+ support programs, TailorMed has supported over 75 million patients and secured more than $7.4 billion in financial assistance since 2020. TailorMed's platform connects patients, providers, pharmacies, and life sciences companies through one coordinated network designed to reach every patient at every step of their medication journey.

Learn more at

About the Role:

The Customer Success Manager serves as an advocate and the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts, ensuring customers are fully engaged and deriving maximum value from our solutions. In this role, you’ll guide clients through the entire customer journey—from onboarding to ongoing support to renewal—not only providing exceptional service, but identifying opportunities to expand and provide even greater ROI for our clients.

You’ll be responsible for driving the adoption of our software, helping to resolve issues, and proactively promoting new features and best practices to maximize customer success and usage of our solution. As the day-to-day contact for your accounts, you will build strong relationships and ensure that each customer is receiving maximum value from our solution. Additionally, you’ll collaborate closely with our Product and R&D teams, acting as the voice of the customer to provide feedback and drive continuous improvement.

This hands-on role is perfect for someone passionate about commercially focused customer success and eager to make a direct impact by ensuring customers are satisfied and successful with TailorMed’s solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Become a trusted advisor to customers, key stakeholders, and executive sponsors
  • Collaborate with TailorMed’s commercial team to identify growth opportunities, supporting account renewals and expansions
  • Define, measure, and communicate ROI for our customers, throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Lead QBRs and EBRs on a regular basis, and accurately reflect to customers their means to success while calling out any red flags
  • Handle commercial items such as renewals, churn prevention, and expansion opportunities
  • Be the product expert, advising customers on use cases and product functionality
  • Simplify and project manage any customer issues to ensure clarity and progress towards both short- and long-term solutions
  • Coordinate various cross-functional teams at TailorMed and throughout the ecosystem, to ensure customers get what they need to connect their applications, data, and devices, and receive an excellent and consistent customer experience, all the time, every time
  • Represent the voice of the customer to our Product and R&D teams to help them innovate new features and improvements
  • Keep current on new product releases and continuously educate your customers on how new features can benefit their business

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of customer success or account management experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment; experience in the healthcare space is ideal
  • Experience with transformation or program management at an organization-wide level
  • Demonstrated ability to help customers use products effectively and increase their satisfaction, and a passion for providing excellent customer service
  • Comfortable communicating and managing relationships with different levels of stakeholders
  • Experience successfully navigating renewals with complex customers
  • Successfully identifying expansion opportunities that led to account growth
  • Analytical, strategic thinker and a proactive problem solver
  • Polished verbal and written communication skills
  • Technical understanding to credibly partner with IT organizations
  • Track record of performance and a growth mindset
  • Ability to influence action within and outside of your own team
  • Ability to drive change within our customers’ and internal organizations
  • Deliver on unique initiatives or critical business issues within complex environments
  • Ability to travel approximately 20% of the time
  • Bachelor's Degree

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, a wide range of voluntary and supplemental benefits, and 24/7 benefits access and support - all effective from your first day of work
  • 401(k) plan with a 4% employer match
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave
  • Six weeks of paid parental leave
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • New MacBook, plus all of the equipment and technology you’ll need to be successful in your role

Description

Salesforce AssociateAccount Executive

Location: US / Canada (Eastern Time) - Home based

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

Job Summary

AllCloud is seeking an Associate Account Executive to support the sale of professional services associated with the Salesforce platform. In this role, you will generate new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, and you will partner closely with senior Account Executives to help develop and grow existing client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional to build a foundation in consultative, solution-based selling within a fast-growing cloud services practice, while receiving direct mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Growth:

  • Strategic Account Support: Support the growth of key strategic accounts — building relationships with business stakeholders, contributing to long-term Salesforce roadmaps, and helping identify Statements of Work for professional services and managed services engagements.
  • Account Roadmaps: Learn to build and extend multi-year Salesforce roadmaps that incorporate new Clouds, and help surface cross-sell opportunities for the AWS and Data & AI (Platforms) team.
  • Quarterly Business Reviews: Prepare and, over time, independently deliver QBRs — owning the agenda, deck, pre-read, and follow-up.
  • Executive Alignment Calls: Help set up and run recurring executive alignment calls, working closely with Project Managers and delivery leadership.

Sales Development & Pipeline:

  • Prospecting & Lead Generation: Generate net-new pipeline through LinkedIn social selling, Salesforce channel introductions, industry events, and targeted outreach.
  • Deal & SOW Support: Learn AllCloud's scoping and SOW process end-to-end — helping to scope, price, and advance deals under mentorship, with the goal of doing so independently.
  • Whitespace & Expansion: Identify expansion opportunities within the existing account base and build whitespace analyses for key accounts.
  • CRM Hygiene: Keep Salesforce accurate and current — opportunities, contacts, pipeline, and forecasts updated weekly.

Channel, Delivery & Thought Leadership

  • Salesforce Channel Relationships: Build and maintain relationships with Salesforce Account Directors, communicate account updates, and help identify co-sell and whitespace opportunities.
  • Delivery Coordination: Work effectively with Project Managers and Solution Architects to manage account health, prepare for executive reviews, and navigate delivery escalations.
  • Thought Leadership: Develop points of view relevant to target verticals, contribute to blog posts, LinkedIn content, and case studies, and represent AllCloud credibly at ecosystem events.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree: A degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Finance, or a related field is preferred.

Experience

  • 1-3 years of entry-level professional experience, internships, or a background in basic sales, client support, or lead generation.
  • Proven ability to assist senior Account Executives with research, client presentations, and managing smaller accounts.

Core Skills

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to pitch services and engage with clients.
  • Platform Knowledge: Understanding of the Salesforce platform's capabilities, with some experience positioning Salesforce solutions to solve business challenges across sales, service, and marketing.
  • Organization: Strong time-management skills to track client meetings, follow-ups, and sales pipelines.
  • Interpersonal Skills: A customer-oriented, proactive, and resilient personality.

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

AllCloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA DGX Cloud is the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs.
raw.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloud is the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs. As a Security Engineer within our Infrastructure Security Engineering organization, you will not just help "secure" our platform—you will architect and build the foundational security primitives that protect massive-scale GPU clusters. You will design automated, resilient security systems that help ensure the integrity of our omni-cloud and on-premise AI infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Security Engineering: Design, build, and integrate production-grade security services. You will focus on the engineering of security products—transforming third-party and open-source tools into seamless, API-driven components of the DGX Cloud security stack.

  • Automated Policy Enforcement: Shift security "left" by developing Infrastructure as Code and Policy as Code to automate security enforcement and compliance at the speed of cloud-scale deployment.

  • Orchestration Security & Guardrails: Architect and implement the security control plane. You will engineer automated guardrails, controllers, and runtime security policies that validate and enforce the integrity of tenant boundaries.

  • Security-as-a-Service Approach: Designing and operating security services as a scalable platform. Building "self-service" security primitives (e.g., Identity-as-a-Service, automated secrets management, and real-time scanning APIs) that allow developer teams to move fast.

  • Security Tooling & Lifecycle: Develop internal security frameworks and automated response systems. Responsible for the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) of the security tools, including testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Threat Modeling & System Design: Conduct deep-dive threat models on complex distributed systems and the DGX Cloud stack, identifying architectural gaps in security and engineering the solutions to close them.

  • Multi-Functional Collaboration: Partner with DGX Cloud platform teams, broader NVIDIA security teams, and product engineering to understand their needs and build paved paths that seamlessly embed security into the CI/CD pipeline and the hardware lifecycle.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineers with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building resilient security systems—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Infrastructure Engineering: Experience (typically 8+ years) in SRE, Software Engineering, and Infrastructure Security. You focus on building systemic solutions rather than performing manual operations or "tool administration."

  • Production-Grade Coding: A strong software engineering background with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. You should be comfortable building and maintaining production service at scale.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and the security challenges inherent in high-throughput, low-latency environments.

  • Platformizing Security: Transform complex security requirements into consumable internal services. You will focus on the "Developer Experience" of security, ensuring that our infrastructure security controls are delivered as robust, API-first platforms that integrate seamlessly with NVIDIA’s internal engineering workflows.

  • Security Product Integration: Proven track record of taking complex security products (AuthN/AuthZ, Vaulting, Scanning, IDS) and integrating them into an automated infrastructure via APIs and custom glue-code.

  • Linux Internals: Strong hands-on experience with Linux systems security, including kernel-level primitives (eBPF, AppArmor, or SELinux).

  • Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • HPC/AI Security: Experience securing high-performance computing environments, RDMA-based networks, or GPU-specific security challenges.

  • Cloud-Native Identity: Expertise in workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and hardware-root-of-trust (TPM/HSM) integration.

  • Open Source Impact: Notable contributions to security-focused open-source projects or a track record of engineering-focused security research. How have you represented and helped advance the industry?

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
170,000 CAD – 220,000 CAD for Level 4; and 225,000 CAD – 275,000 CAD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until .

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Overview Company Summary MasTec Professional Services, a subsidiary of MasTec, provides customer solutions through feasibility studies, design and engineering services, turnkey EPC delivery, surveys, constructability reviews, consulting studies and design-build services. The Senior Electrical Engineer will support commercial, industrial, renewable, and mission-critical projects, including data center electrical infrastructure and substation design. This role requires independent technical execution, collaboration across disciplines, and direct client/project engagement. Job Summary The Senior Electrical Engineer is responsible for leading portions of multi-discipline design projects related to power distribution, substation design, renewable energy systems, and mission-critical facilities such as data centers. This role includes performing engineering analyses, developing designs, PE-sealing construction documents, supporting construction, and mentoring junior staff while working under general supervision of project managers. ** OPEN TO REMOTE CANDIDATES ** Responsibilities Produce preliminary and final design drawings using computer aided drafting systems for: Power distribution systems – commercial, industrial, etc. Substations, switchgear Data center electrical infrastructure Renewable energy collection systems Perform engineering calculations such as: Load flow, short circuit, coordination, and voltage drop Equipment sizing and conductor selection Grounding, underground thermal ampacity, and cable pulling Apply and interpret applicable codes and standards (NEC, NESC, IEEE, ANSI, utility standards). Lead portions of project design efforts, coordinating with civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines. Ensure project engineering activities comply with company and contract requirements and support overall construction schedule. Perform field surveys and prepare accurate field sketches; record verifications, prepare documentation and construction prints. Issue PE-sealed drawings and reports and provide technical support for construction, including participation in construction planning, execution, quality control, and completion of the work. Maintain project records for assigned work, package records per contract requirements and facilitate turnover to the client’s representative. Responsible for ongoing communication and timely identification of issues and pending or actual changes to the work performed that may impact costs, schedule, contract or customer relationship. Review RFP’s, prepare fee estimates and proposals. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications Experience with substation design (e.g., one-line diagrams, protection schemes, grounding systems) Experience with data center design (tiered/redundant systems, backup generation, UPS systems) Experience reviewing construction drawings and supporting commissioning activities Physical Demands and Work Environment This job operates in both a professional office environment and field settings (including substations and active construction/data center sites). Standard office equipment is routinely used. The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform essential functions. This role is primarily sedentary but includes fieldwork requiring walking, climbing, and occasional lifting (up to 50 pounds). Additional Information Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. The Company reserves the right to revise or change the job duties as the need arises. Management reserves the right to change the description, duties, or work schedules to accommodate individuals with disabilities. Benefits available include Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance, a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase plan. MasTec is publicly traded (NYSE: MTZ). raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

The Global Payroll Operations Partner is responsible for the successful operational delivery, validation and oversight of assigned payrolls and legal entities. Acting as the primary operational owner for a portfolio of payrolls, countries and entities, this role ensures payrolls are delivered accurately, compliantly and on time through effective payroll validation, issue resolution, stakeholder management and vendor management.

The Payroll Operations Partner works closely with HR Service Delivery, Finance, Reward, Benefits, Technology teams and external payroll providers to deliver a seamless payroll experience while maintaining strong controls, compliance and operational excellence.

As the payroll function continues to evolve, this role will increasingly leverage data, automation, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to improve payroll outcomes, enhance employee experience and generate business insights.

This role reports to the Payroll Manager.


The day-to-day

Payroll Portfolio Ownership

  • Act as the operational owner for assigned payrolls, countries and legal entities.
  • Maintain accountability for payroll delivery and operational outcomes within assigned payroll portfolios.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and payroll providers.
  • Manage payroll-related risks, dependencies and operational issues.
  • Escalate significant risks or service issues appropriately.

Data Quality & Exception Management

  • Investigate payroll-impacting data issues and discrepancies.
  • Monitor integration exceptions and payroll-related data issues.
  • Partner with HR Service Delivery and other stakeholders to resolve root causes.
  • Identify recurring data quality concerns and support long-term resolution.

Vendor & Service Management

  • Act as the primary operational contact for payroll providers supporting assigned payrolls.
  • Monitor service quality and responsiveness.
  • Support operational vendor reviews and improvement discussions.
  • Escalate service delivery concerns through established governance channels.
  • Build effective working relationships with payroll vendors and service partners.

Employee & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide payroll expertise and support to employees, managers and internal stakeholders.
  • Resolve complex payroll enquiries and escalations through ServiceNow and other channels.
  • Deliver a responsive and employee-focused service experience.
  • Act as a trusted payroll partner for assigned payroll portfolios.

Compliance & Controls

  • Execute payroll controls in accordance with the Global Payroll Governance Framework.
  • Complete reconciliations, validations and payroll approval activities.
  • Support audit requests, compliance reviews and governance activities.
  • Ensure payroll procedures are followed consistently.
  • Escalate compliance concerns, control failures and operational risks.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain country and payroll-specific procedures.
  • Ensure payroll documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Support annual reviews of payroll processes and controls.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and cross-training activities.

Continuous Improvement, Data & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll quality, efficiency and employee experience.
  • Use payroll data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Support automation, process simplification and standardisation initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas that increase the value of payroll data and insights.
  • Support the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and automation solutions.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years payroll experience within a complex payroll environment.
  • Experience working with outsourced payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll validation, controls and reconciliations.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Experience managing payroll issues, exceptions and escalations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience using HRIS and payroll technology platforms.
  • Strong Excel and data analysis capability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, entities or payroll providers.

What will help you on the job

  • Experience working within a multinational organisation.
  • Experience with Workday.
  • Payroll qualification (CPP, CIPP or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting payroll transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with payroll integrations and automation solutions.
  • Ability to interpret payroll data and identify business insights and trends.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled, analytics-driven or technology-led payroll operating models.

Our remote team of above 60 members operates collaboratively to drive impactful, sustainable solutions for climate-related challenges.

·Create and refine event branding materials, including logos, promotional posters, digital assets, and event print materials

·Develop designs across multiple formats such as social media, brochures, flex banners, hanging flexes, stationery materials, booklets, and print announcements

Remote. The position is entirely remote, and candidates from any location in India are encouraged to apply.

About Appriss Retail

Appriss Retail is the total retail loss solution for omnichannel, unifying high-quality data across stores, online, and customer ser-vice to reduce returns, cut shrink, and manage incidents. Our products—Engage to reduce returns, Secure to cut shrink, and Incident to centralize visibility—help retailers move from reactive loss control to strategic profit protection. Together, they empower organizations to make better operations decisions, strengthen accountability, and put hundreds of millions back to the bottom line. Covering 40% of all U.S. transactions and active in 45 countries, Appriss Retail is trusted by 60+ of the top 100 U.S. retailers to deliver lasting performance improvement. Learn more at apprissretail.com.

Overview

This next-generation SDR role owns outbound campaigns aimed at senior retail leaders and books qualified meetings with executive buyers, using AI and signal-driven, account-based strategies. You’ll work closely with Growth Marketing and Sales to personalize outreach at scale and continuously optimize your approach. The ideal candidate is curious, tenacious, and eager to grow as a key contributor to pipeline success.

Essential Duties

  • AI-Outbound Campaign Ownership –Builds, launches, and updates outbound campaigns end to end by persona, competitor, industry, event, and market trend. Uses AI-based tools, signals from the signal agent, sequence performance, and market research to decide what to change, reach the right executives at the right time with specific, relevant messaging, and generate qualified meetings with executive buyers.
  • NextGen ABM Collaboration– Partners with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, and Growth Marketing to co-build contact- and account-based outbound strategies, targeting high-value accounts and executives with creative, scalable outreach that drives pipeline and builds meaningful relationships with key decision-makers. Shares what is learned in the market to sharpen positioning.
  • Sales Partnership & Alignment– Works closely with sales reps on account prioritization and targeting. Runs regular check-ins with the reps to ensure seamless handoffs, align messaging, and maximize conversion from meeting to opportunity.
  • Data-Driven Performance – Tracks key metrics, analyzes outreach performance, tests what works, reports results, and iterates quickly to improve meeting conversion rates and pipeline contribution.
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation – Stays current on AI tools, sales technology, and outreach best practices to push the limits of modern SDR effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Two years or more of related experience required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or similar software.
  • Proficient in Claude Cowork.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with retail and returns management.

Benefits

At Appriss Retail, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at work and beyond. Benefits begin on your first day and include multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, health savings and flexible spending accounts, paid parental leave, and supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments. We offer generous paid time off, a 401(k) with immediate vesting and company match, short- and long-term disability, and free access to health and wellbeing resources such as Calm Health. You’ll also have access to learning and development opportunities to help you grow your career. Our benefits support your well-being so you can perform your best in every part of life.

This role is eligible for up to $50,000 in annual commission based on performance.

Reports to: Director of Growth Operations

About National Council of Urban Indian Health

The National Council of Urban Indian Health (NCUIH) was founded to represent the interests of Urban Indian Organizations (UIOs) before Congress and Federal agencies and influence policies impacting the health conditions experienced by urban American Indians and Alaska Natives (AI/ANs). NCUIH is a 501(c)(3), membership-based organization devoted to supporting the development of quality, accessible, and culturally sensitive healthcare programs for AI/ANs living in urban communities. NCUIH provides advocacy, education, training, and leadership for urban Indian healthcare providers and represents UIOs funded through Title V of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act and the AI/ANs they serve.

Position Summary

The Director of Communications & Events (Director) leads NCUIH's communications function and provides strategic oversight of its annual conference of more than 300 participants and other assigned events. The Director manages staff, leads editorial priorities, digital platforms and communications deliverables across NCUIH's grants and organizational priorities. The Director supervises communications staff and an Events Manager, who is responsible for day-to-day planning and execution of the conference and other NCUIH events. Working under the direction of the Sr. VP of Policy & Communications, the Director sets priorities, delegates responsibilities, monitors budgets and milestones, and ensures communications and events advance NCUIH's mission.

Duties and Responsibilities

Communications leadership and public engagement

  • Develop and maintain an integrated communications and editorial calendar covering grant products, policy priorities, newsletters, organizational announcements, publications, digital content and events.
  • Supervise communications and events staff and coordinate graphic design, website, social media, newsletter, video and podcast production; allocate work and manage external production support.
  • Maintain NCUIH's brand, editorial standards and communications procedures; lead editing and quality review of public-facing materials and route technical, policy and executive approvals.
  • Develop leadership presentations, talking points, speeches, media materials and public relations campaigns assigned by the Sr. VP of Policy & Communications and CEO.
  • Manage press outreach and inquiries as assigned. Manage website and resource-library updates, email marketing and social media.
  • Monitor audience engagement, maintain accurate distribution lists and improve access to NCUIH resources.
  • Maintain professional engagement with national partners, stakeholders, and advocates and foster strong relationships with key national and regional contacts.

Staff supervision and team management

  • Provide direct supervision, coaching and performance feedback to communications staff and the Events Manager; establish clear responsibilities, goals and deadlines.
  • Manage team capacity and coordinate assignments across communications and events; use shared project plans to track deliverables, internal reviews and dependencies.
  • Support staff development and evaluate performance; resolve workload or execution concerns and elevate decisions requiring senior leadership approval.
  • Oversee processes, procedures and workflows of communications and events.

Grant Communications and Dissemination

  • Translate approved workplans into a production schedule with content owners, review deadlines, design needs, publication dates and dissemination measures across new and existing grants.
  • Lead the communications work for the HRSA HIV project, including the design, production, and promotion of HIV webpages, the resource library and learning platform, fact sheets, clinical guides, educational videos, training announcements, and needs-assessment publications, using substantive content developed by program staff and subject matter experts.
  • Coordinate Office of Minority Health (OMH) communications and language-access planning with TARC.
  • Lead the design, production, and promotion of OMH project materials such as prevention materials, the toolkit, UIO snapshots, SME examples, website resources, audio or virtual products and lessons learned materials, using substantive content developed by program staff and subject matter experts.
  • Manage design and dissemination of funded Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) and (Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAI) guidance, training resources and project findings through webpages, newsletters, direct UIO outreach and other approved channels.
  • Working with TARC staff, ensure materials receive appropriate technical and cultural review and meet plain-language and accessibility standards; coordinate translation, captions, transcripts, alternate formats and consent for identifiable stories and media.
  • Lead efforts to compile communications outputs and reach data, including publication records, distribution, webpage use, email engagement, media views and event participation, for grant reporting and improvement.

Conference planning and event implementation

  • Supervise the Events Manager, who is responsible for the integrated event workplan and day-to-day execution of the annual conference and other assigned events, including logistics, vendors, registration, production, accessibility, volunteers and onsite delivery.
  • Set event goals and priorities; review the Event Manager’s workplans, deliverables, milestones, budget tracking and readiness reports, resolve implementation issues and route procurement, contract and financial approvals to Partnerships and Operations.
  • Lead conference marketing, website and agenda publication, speaker materials, signage, attendee communications and the onsite run of show.
  • Coordinate content approval with the CEO, TARC and Policy & Communications, while the Events Manager manages the operational run of show and onsite execution.
  • Ensure the Events Manager partners with the Development Department to execute the conference; integrate fundraising and partnership milestones, sponsor and exhibitor commitments, recognition and fulfillment into the master plan.
  • Lead communications, production and timelines for other assigned webinars, trainings, regional institutes, receptions and convenings.
  • Supervises the Events Manager on operational planning, vendors, platforms, accessibility, logistics and participant follow-up; supervises and assigns tasks to communications staff on promotion and content production.
  • Lead joint planning meetings and post-conference debriefs with the Director of Development and other departments; review results and the Events Manager’s recommendations, coordinate financial reconciliation with the Director of Finance and ensure improvements are implemented.
  • Other communications tasks and events duties as assigned.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, public relations, event management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least six (6) years of progressively responsible communications experience, managing complex projects or communications production teams.
  • At least two (2) years' experience directly supervising staff, including assigning work and providing performance feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage editorial planning, digital communications, publications, media relations, and simultaneous deadlines.
  • Experience leading planning and implementation of a complex, multi-day conference or comparable event, including budgets, vendors, cross-functional teams and onsite delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to delegate execution and hold staff accountable for results.
  • Excellent writing, editing, judgment, and quality control skills.
  • Ability to translate public health or policy information for different audiences.
  • Working proficiency with Microsoft 365, project management systems, website content management, email marketing, virtual event tools, and design collaboration tools.
  • Commitment to culturally responsive communication and ability to work respectfully with UIOs and American Indian and Alaska Native communities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree, or equivalent advanced professional experience in communications or a related field.
  • Five or more years' experience managing communications for federally funded grants.
  • Experience in Native health, public health, national associations or nonprofit advocacy, including communications for federal grants.
  • Experience with accessible publication design, video or podcast workflows, media strategy and audience analytics.

NCUIH Team Member Perks

  • Annual Leave: 13 days a year, increases after 3 years, accrued bi-weekly
  • Sick/Safe Leave: 13 days a year, accrued bi-weekly
  • 12 paid holidays a year
  • 100% employer-paid medical premiums for employee and one eligible family member, with a $0 deductible
  • 100% employer-paid dental and vision premiums, including orthodontic coverage
  • Employee Assistance Plan
  • Eligible employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)
  • 403(b) participation with up to 5% employer match
  • Employer-paid short- and long-term disability
  • Employer-paid life insurance valued at $50,000
  • Optional employee-paid enrollment in AFLAC supplemental benefits

Work/Life Balance and Flexibility are vital to mental, physical, and spiritual health. NCUIH offers the following benefits

  • Flexible remote work environment (unless specified in the job description)
  • Flexible start times between 8 a.m.–10 a.m. ET
  • Wellness Program, ShareCare, CloseKnit, gym membership discount programs, and virtual behavioral health programs
  • Modern laptop equipment, supplies, and online tools to support an everyday virtual environment

Location:Fully remote, with travel for regional institutes, the annual conference, and other required activities. Occasional evening or weekend event work may be required.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions, and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead Amgen’s Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) marketing strategy. Through deep understanding of customers and treatment paradigms, alongside a diverse cross-functional team, you will build a brand strategy and craft experiences to maximize impact at launch. The ED Global Marketing Lead (GML) for Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) will report to the T2D Indication Team Lead and will be responsible for developing successful global brands as well as developing and implementing global launch strategies and optimizing the impact of marketing budgets.


Responsibilities:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

raw.excerpt: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate.
raw.description:
NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all-in-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently.

About The Role

This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth will made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how our software gets released and run while working closely with other senior engineers.

We operate dozens of .NET services deployed per-customer on Windows Server and IIS in AWS, managed with Terraform and Octopus Deploy. Across hundreds of provider tenants that's thousands of running application instances. Today a change waits for the next release train, and the train then takes weeks to reach the whole fleet, so end-to-end a given feature takes months. Improving our deployment and development experience is the first job. After that there are dozens of areas of platform investment needed to support how fast we're scaling.

What You'll Do

  • Own our CI/CD pipeline end to end, with the authority to change what it deploys and how.
  • Own developer experience. Reproducible builds, a local environment someone can actually stand up, and fast honest feedback on every change. This is half the job, not a side effect of the other half.
  • Get our automated regression suite running in CI. It exists, it's substantial, and it isn't currently executed.
  • Cut release lead time and get the fleet inside a published, committed release window.
  • Make fleet version state answerable by a query instead of by a person, so anyone can see what a customer is running.
  • Design and publish an access model, so provisioning stops routing through one inbox.
  • Start bringing runtimes and dependencies current, beginning with the shared libraries everything else depends on.
  • Document and share what you learn, so infrastructure knowledge stops being concentrated in one place.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering.
  • Production Terraform, including state you owned and drift you had to reconcile.
  • Production Windows Server and IIS, application pools included.
  • End-to-end ownership of a CI/CD pipeline in a previous role.
  • AWS at the level this estate uses it: EC2, ALB, VPC, IAM.
  • A track record of replacing a manual process with a measured and automated one, where you can tell us the before and after.
  • Evidence you've made other engineers faster, not just the systems. Build times, local setup, test feedback, whatever it was.
  • Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again.

Nice to have

  • Octopus Deploy, or another deployment orchestrator you owned.
  • Single-tenant or multi-tenant SaaS at meaningful scale.
  • Healthcare, HIPAA, or another regulated environment.

How we work

This is brownfield and we're honest about it. Some of this estate is well-built and some of it grew. We're not asking you to rewrite it, because hundreds of providers bill claims through it every day. We're asking you to make it measurable, make it safe to change, then change it. If you've built a career inheriting other people's systems and making them boring, you'll like it here.

We work with AI agents, seriously. The team works agentically and so will you. What matters is what you do after the agent produces something: tests, linters, project instructions, a loop you can run again. If your answer to a bad result is a longer prompt, we're probably not a fit. This is also why developer experience sits in this role rather than somewhere else: an agent is only as good as the feedback loop it runs in, and ours needs work.

Most application development is done by a long-standing engineering partner. You'd own the pipeline, the infrastructure, and the environments, and over time the standards their code meets before it ships while working closely with our off-shore development team.

Two people isn't a platform team, it's the start of one. Until it's three, coverage is shared between you, the CTO, and our head of engineering. Everyone here is remote, and we'd like your hours to overlap the US East Coast.

This is the start of the engineering team, not the end of it. We're hiring more engineers through 2027. The people who join first get the widest scope, the most say in how the team gets built, and first choice about what they own as it grows.

How to apply

Apply through the link on this page. Instead of a cover letter, we ask one question: tell us about a system you inherited, and the first thing you measured. A few sentences is plenty.

Use AI to help write your application if you want to, we do too. We read every one ourselves, and we can tell when nobody read the posting.

Your first conversation will be with our CTO, who is the hiring manager and will walk you through the rest of the process.

Compensation and benefits

  • The range shown for this role is base salary, and does not include equity or bonus. We post it because we expect to pay inside it.
  • Equity in the company.
  • Medical / dental / vision, 401(k) - up to 4% matching, Unlimited PTO policy

This is a remote role, but candidates must be based in the U.S.

Desirable

About Kreato Global

At Kreato Global, we believe communication is a fundamental human right. Since 2020, Kreato USA Services LLC has provided professional interpreting across healthcare, legal, financial, customer service and community settings. Our services include over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), video remote interpretation (VRI), on-site interpretation and American Sign Language (ASL).

We’re growing our network of remote ASL interpreters who care about accessibility, accuracy and making a real difference in people’s lives.

The role

As a Remote ASL Interpreter, you’ll make communication possible between Deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals and hearing participants over secure video. About 90% of assignments are medical; the other 10% are general community settings.

What you’ll do

  • Interpret ASL ↔ spoken English through our secure VRI platform
  • Facilitate accurate, culturally appropriate communication between Deaf and hard-of-hearing patients, their families and healthcare providers
  • Follow the RID Code of Professional Conduct, standards of practice and applicable regulations
  • Protect patient privacy and comply with HIPAA
  • Stay professional, calm and compassionate, including in sensitive or stressful situations
  • Complete daily activity logs and required documentation accurately and on time

Requirements

  • RID national certification, or another recognized ASL interpreting certification
  • State license or registration, if your state requires one
  • At least 1 year of professional interpreting experience (medical or VRI experience preferred)
  • Strong command of ASL and English, written and spoken
  • Comfortable with video technology and basic troubleshooting
  • Must live in the United States

Remote setup requirements

  • Computer with a webcam and headset
  • Reliable high-speed internet (wired connection preferred)
  • A private, quiet, well-lit workspace where no one else can see or hear sessions
  • A plain, neutral background

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Pay close attention to detail and own the quality of your work
  • Handle confidential information with discretion
  • Adapt easily to different people, settings and communication needs
  • Work well independently and follow established procedures

Why interpreters work with us

  • Fully remote, on-demand work: you choose when to log in
  • Steady weekday demand in healthcare settings
  • Meaningful work that improves access to care
  • A team that values your expertise and professionalism

How to apply

Apply through JazzHR with your résumé. Include your certifications and, if applicable, your state license. Credentials are verified, and onboarding must be completed before you can receive assignments.

Role summary

We are hiring an SAP Service Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of SAP Application Management Services (AMS) and project engagements for our clients. The role is accountable for SLA performance, client satisfaction, team management and commercial health of the account.

The ideal candidate has run SAP ECC and S/4HANA support landscapes, can talk confidently with CFOs and IT heads, and keeps a multi-module team (FICO, MM, SD, PP, HCM, ABAP, Basis, Security) delivering to agreed service levels.

Key responsibilities

Service delivery and SLA management

  • Own day-to-day delivery of SAP AMS services: incidents, service requests, change requests and minor enhancements.
  • Meet contracted SLAs and KPIs for response, resolution and backlog; drive root-cause analysis for P1/P2 and repeat incidents.
  • Run ITIL processes: incident, problem, change, release and knowledge management, using ServiceNow, Solution Manager / Cloud ALM or Jira.
  • Govern transport and release management across DEV, QAS and PRD with clear approval controls.

Client and stakeholder management

  • Be the single point of contact for client IT and business leadership, including finance and operations heads.
  • Run weekly status calls and monthly / quarterly service reviews with executive summaries, SLA dashboards and improvement plans.
  • Manage escalations calmly and close them with clear action plans and timelines.
  • Identify upsell opportunities: S/4HANA upgrades, new modules, automation and CRs.

Team leadership

  • Lead and mentor a multi-module team of functional, technical, Basis and Security consultants, onsite and offshore.
  • Plan shift coverage, on-call rosters, leave and backup for 24x7 or business-hours support models.
  • Set goals, review performance and build skills through cross-training and certifications.
  • Coordinate between functional, ABAP, Basis and integration teams to resolve cross-module issues quickly.

Commercial and governance

  • Track effort, utilisation, billing and margins; manage SOWs, change orders and invoicing inputs.
  • Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and keep delivery audit-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data-privacy and client audit requirements (SOX / internal controls where applicable).
  • Lead service transition for new accounts, including knowledge transfer and hypercare.

Continuous improvement

  • Reduce ticket volumes through automation, monitoring, self-service and permanent fixes.
  • Support project work alongside AMS: S/4HANA conversions, rollouts, upgrades and support packs.
  • Publish lessons learned and keep runbooks and knowledge articles current.

Required skills and experience
  • 12–16 years in IT, with at least 5 years as Service Delivery Manager, AMS Manager or Engagement Manager for SAP accounts.
  • Hands-on SAP background (8+ years) in at least one module — FICO, SD, MM or PP preferred — with working knowledge of how modules integrate.
  • Proven delivery of SAP ECC and S/4HANA support, including at least one S/4HANA conversion, upgrade or rollout.
  • Strong ITIL process knowledge and experience with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Solution Manager / Cloud ALM).
  • Track record of meeting SLAs on accounts with multi-module teams of 15+ people.
  • Experience with commercials: SOWs, effort estimation, resource planning, utilisation and margin tracking.
  • Excellent client-facing communication; comfortable presenting to CXO-level stakeholders.
  • Experience working with Middle East or global clients and distributed onsite–offshore teams is a strong plus.
  • Willingness to travel to client locations for reviews, transitions and critical phases.

Preferred qualifications
  • Education: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / MBA, or CA / ICWA for a finance-background candidate.
  • Certifications (any of): ITIL v4 Foundation or higher, PMP or PRINCE2, SAP S/4HANA module certification, SAP Activate.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, Cloud ALM, Fiori, and integration (CPI / PI-PO, bank and EDI interfaces).
  • Experience with automation and monitoring tools that reduce ticket volume.
  • Prior experience in an IT services or consulting firm handling multiple clients.

raw.description:
¿Eres un apasionado de la programación?

En idealista, estamos ampliando nuestro equipo perfiles senior para nuestro equipo de tecnología.

Sí te gusta estar rodeado de buen@s compañer@s, trabajar con buen rollo y en un ambiente colaborativo ¡sigue leyendo! seguro que idealista te va a gustar 😉

¿Qué harás?

  • Trabajarás junto a tus compañer@s del equipo desarrollando nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Tendrás un trato fluido con la gente de negocio para poder entender sus necesidades y problemas. Además, trabajarás codo con codo con nuestro equipo de producto y UX para aportar una visión técnica a las soluciones que definamos para los mismos.
  • Ayudarás a que la plataforma esté estable…Sí, en idealista también tenemos bugs, así que tendrás que ayudar a identificarlos y solucionarlos.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Podrás ver el impacto directo de tu trabajo en una de las webs de referencia tanto en España, como en Italia y Portugal. Para los que no lo hayáis vivido ya: no sabéis el cosquilleo que da en la tripa la primera vez que ves algo que has hecho en una plataforma que utilizan millones de personas.
  • Somos Remote Friendly :) pero tenemos oficinas en el centro de Madrid para vernos de vez en cuando.
  • Vas a aprender. Lo decimos en serio. La plataforma va evolucionando constantemente, y de ahí sacamos mogollón de charlas internas, posts, talleres… que hacen que el conocimiento fluya.
  • Además... patrocinamos eventos, acudimos a ellos y hacemos muchos meetups. ¡Es tan importante aprender como enseñar a tus compis!
  • Además de tu salario, podrás acogerte a un plan de retribución flexible (tarjeta de transporte, cheques gourmet, seguro médico…) del que te podrás beneficiar desde el primer día.
  • Clases de Inglés, italiano y portugués.
  • Fruta fresca y café siempre disponible en la cocina.
  • ¡También tenemos fisio y clases de yoga … porque para nosotros lo más importante es cuidar de nuestros idealistas!
  • Además de trabajar, nos gusta pasarlo bien, por eso que si te unes a nuestra familia, cada mes celebrarás algo…Halloween, San Valentín, Navidad,…¡Te lo vas a pasar muy bien!
  • Teambuilding y mucho más!

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

  • Tienes al menos 3 años de experiencia desarrollando el backend de alguna aplicación utilizando Java, y nos puedes hablar de ello.
  • Nosotr@s trabajamos principalmente con Java y Spring pero lo que de verdad nos interesa es que tengas ciertos fundamentos de programación bien asentados.
  • No te quedas en el “con que funcione vale”. Nosotr@s damos mucho valor tanto a las buenas prácticas, como a definir diseños y arquitecturas que nos permitan extender la plataforma de manera sostenible. Así que esperamos que estos sean términos a los que tú también les des importancia.
  • Nosotr@s trabajamos en equipo. El equipo son tus compañer@s; pero también lo es la gente de producto y UX, así como la gente de negocio, etc.
  • Te gusta este mundillo. Y te encanta saber que vas a tener que estar aprendiendo durante toda tu vida laboral. Además, eres lo suficientemente humilde como para aceptar las enseñanzas de tus compañeros, y lo suficientemente generoso como para compartir con ellos tu conocimiento :)
  • Tienes curiosidad e iniciativa. Al final, este trabajo va de los problemas que somos capaces de resolver y de cómo logramos hacerlo. Así que se espera de ti que seas capaz de analizar, preguntar, pedir ayuda (y ofrecerla), y saber plantear soluciones a los mismos.

¿Qué otras cosas son un plus?

  • Además de haberte pegado con la parte de backend, tienes soltura con el front.
  • Sientes curiosidad y has experimentado al menos con otros paradigmas de programación como la programación funcional.
  • Valoramos además que te desenvuelvas mínimamente en la lengua de Shakespeare. A nivel de lectura es indispensable, porque el 80% del material técnico en nuestra profesión es en inglés. Si además lo hablas con cierta soltura, muchísimo mejor!

Estamos deseando conocerte y que nos conozcas.

¿Aceptas el reto?

  • Assists in the analysis of clinical output of studies and preparation of clinical investigational reports.
  • Develops study materials in collaboration with others within the organization and leads the execution of site training.
  • Promotes a positive work environment that stresses and demonstrates cooperation and mutual support for internal and external colleagues.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Behaviors:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field – Cath Lab experience is a plus
  • 5+ years of relevant clinical trial operations/clinical research/clinical monitoring experience, preferably with catheters; solid history of experience in medical device or another regulated clinical environment a plus
