What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a detail-oriented MiPACS Administrator & Identity & Security Analyst to support the administration, maintenance, and day-to-day operations of the MiPACS dental imaging platform while assisting with Epic security, identity and access management (IAM), user provisioning, and access governance activities.

This role will work closely with Health Center staff, IT teams, and vendors to ensure dental imaging systems operate effectively and users receive appropriate, secure, and role-based access to Epic and other supported applications and systems. The position will also participate in security governance activities, application testing, implementations, and ongoing operational support.

Key Responsibilities

MiPACS Administration & Support

  • Assist with the day-to-day administration and support of the MiPACS dental imaging platform.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and workstation configurations.
  • Troubleshoot dental imaging issues, including intraoral sensors, panoramic imaging equipment, and image connectivity.
  • Monitor system performance and coordinate issue resolution with vendors and technical support teams.
  • Assist with software updates, testing, documentation, and system maintenance activities.
  • Support onboarding and user training, including importing/exporting X-rays, creating MiPACS series and mounts, and ensuring local MiPACS servers synchronize properly.
  • Maintain documentation related to system configurations and operational processes.

Identity & Security Administration

  • Support the creation, modification, transfer, and deactivation of user accounts within Epic and other enterprise applications.
  • Provision and maintain role-based Epic security access using established security templates and organizational standards.
  • Support employee, provider, contractor, and third-party user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding.
  • Review access requests and ensure required approvals are obtained before provisioning access.
  • Assist with periodic access reviews, security audits, and remediation activities.
  • Support the investigation and resolution of Epic security and access-related incidents and service requests.
  • Maintain Epic security documentation, access matrices, provisioning procedures, and security standards.
  • Support multifactor authentication (MFA), identity verification, and account recovery processes.
  • Assist with testing security changes during Epic upgrades, implementations, and Health Center go-lives.
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA requirements and Health Choice Network security standards.
  • Participate in Security Workgroup activities supporting security enhancements and access governance initiatives.

General Technical Support

  • Document technical issues, resolutions, and recurring system problems.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation and user guides.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to senior technical staff and vendors as needed.
  • Participate in application testing, upgrades, and implementation projects.
  • Provide professional and responsive customer service to internal teams and Health Centers.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Health Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • One (1) to three (3) years of experience in IT support, application administration, help desk operations, or healthcare technology support preferred.
  • Ability to obtain foundational Epic Security Certification and complete required MiPACS training.
  • Basic understanding of user account administration and access management.
  • General knowledge of Windows operating systems and computer hardware.
  • Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to learn new applications and technical processes.
  • Strong customer service orientation and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare IT applications or Electronic Health Records (EHRs).
  • Exposure to Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts and processes.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience supporting dental imaging systems, PACS platforms, or image management applications.
  • Basic understanding of networking, workstation configurations, and application integrations.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and healthcare information security principles.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

- 100% Remote Work – Work from anywhere in the U.S.
-100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance on one of our health plans

- Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

- 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Contribution
- Professional Development & Education Assistance
- Mission-Driven Culture Focused on Community Health

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

raw.description:
Position Summary

As ICU Medical transitions to Workday, this role will support the implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution of the Workday platform. The analyst will bring depth in one or more Workday modules (such as HCM) and apply that expertise across other modules and functional areas as business needs and priorities change. Working under the direction of the Workday Program Manager, the HRIS Manager and senior project team members, this position will partner with functional HR and business leaders to gather requirements, configure and test solutions, validate data, and ensure business needs are accurately reflected in Workday. The role will also support post-go-live needs and the broader Workday roadmap, and will work with the primary reporting owner to ensure reporting needs are met and no business gaps are created with the deployment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Workday Implementation & Support

  • Support the implementation of Workday across the HR platform, with an area of focus in one or more modules (such as HCM), and extend support to other modules and functional areas as needed.

  • Partner with HR and business stakeholders to gather, document, and validate requirements, and translate them into configuration specifications.

  • Configure and test Workday functionality, including business process definitions, condition rules, notifications, and approval workflows.

  • Support data validation by reviewing and confirming that data loaded into Workday is complete and accurate, and by identifying and reporting discrepancies to the data conversion team for resolution.

  • Partner with the test administrator to ensure test scenarios are fully built out, accurately reflect business requirements and configuration, and are ready for execution; support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and parallel testing, and track and resolve test defects.

  • Support Workday security configuration, ensuring appropriate access to data and alignment with privacy and compliance requirements.

  • Support additional Workday modules, processes, and initiatives as business needs and priorities evolve.

Reporting Support

  • Partner with the primary Workday reporting owner to communicate reporting requirements and ensure current-state reporting needs are met at go-live.

  • Run audit and reconciliation reports to support data validation, confirming that all data from legacy systems was loaded accurately into Workday during validation cycles and after go-live.

  • Provide subject matter input on report data sources, security, and field definitions, and support basic ad hoc reporting needs as directed.

Post Go-Live & Platform Roadmap Support

  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization, including troubleshooting transactions, resolving data issues, triaging and tracking open issues and enhancement requests, and responding to HR and employee inquiries.

  • Support the broader Workday platform roadmap by gathering and assessing HR and business needs, documenting requirements, and helping prioritize enhancements and future-phase deployments across modules.

  • Partner with the HRIS team and the Workday project team to plan, configure, and test roadmap items, ensuring changes are well documented and aligned with the overall platform strategy.

Team & Platform Partnership

  • Support Workday bi-annual releases by assessing potential impacts to Workday functionality, conducting regression testing, and implementing required updates.

  • Collaborate closely with the HRIS team, the Workday project team, the reporting owner, and integration and functional leads on configuration changes and enhancements that affect Workday data and processes.

  • Contribute to documentation, standards, naming conventions, and training materials.

  • Advise on data quality, governance, and audit readiness for Workday data.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of at least one Workday module (such as HCM, Absence, Benefits, Time, Compensation, Recruiting, or Talent), with the ability and willingness to learn and support additional modules.
  • Experience validating data loaded into Workday, including reconciling source data to Workday reports.
  • Working knowledge of Workday reporting tools and calculated fields sufficient to validate data and support the reporting owner.
  • Ability to gather and translate business requirements into clear, scalable configuration solutions and to support a long-term platform roadmap.
  • Strong ability to prioritize work, manage time independently, and follow through on tasks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic project management skills, including scoping work, planning tasks, and communicating progress.
  • This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments and requires excellent judgment and interpersonal skills.
  • Natural self-starter and creative problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset.

Minimum Qualifications, Education & Experience

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent relevant work experience, is preferred.

  • 6+ years of hands-on Workday experience in a production environment; Workday implementation and post-go-live support experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Workday module configuration and business processes in one or more areas. Workday certification in a relevant module preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Workday Security concepts including domain and business process security policies and security groups.
  • Working knowledge of Workday reporting, including report fields and calculated fields.

Work Environment

  • This is largely a sedentary role.

  • Typically requires travel less than 5% of the time.

About us:

Braveheart Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) and other serious cardiovascular diseases. Our lead product candidate, BHB-1893, is a next-generation oral small-molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor (CMI) being developed for the treatment of obstructive HCM (oHCM) and non-obstructive HCM (nHCM). Braveheart’s goal is to improve the treatment options for these patients by enhancing speed of onset, depth of gradient response, systolic safety, reversibility and reducing prescribing complexity.

With a proven leadership team, a strong financial foundation, and a high-value late-stage asset, Braveheart Bio represents an outstanding opportunity for ambitious, mission-driven professionals to make a tangible impact in a high-profile and rapidly evolving therapeutic area.

The role:

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) is a key leader within the Clinical Operations team and will report to the Associate Director, Clinical Operations. The Sr. CTM will serve as study lead, with responsibility for the end-to-end operational delivery of a study in collaboration with other study leads across the program, and under the direction of the Associate Director, Clinical Operations. This includes providing strategic oversight of study execution, vendor management, financial accountability, and cross-functional alignment.

Key responsibilities:

  • May serve as study lead for one or more global clinical trials, overseeing day-to-day execution from start-up through close-out (including site activation, enrollment, study conduct, and close-out) under the guidance of the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Partner closely with the Clinical Operations study leads on key decisions by providing recommendations, proactively identifying risks, and escalating critical issues with proposed mitigation strategies.
  • Help drive study timelines, deliverables, and operational plans, ensuring alignment with overall program strategy, as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations. Monitor study metrics, including data quality, protocol deviations, and site performance, and drive appropriate follow-up actions, as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • May oversee and support regional study execution, including site selection strategy, site start-up, and study progress; ensure efficient and timely study start-up across regions, as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations. Oversee and participate in the review of informed consent forms and regulatory submission packages as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Perform visits (PSSVs, SIVs, RMVs) as required to demonstrate appropriate oversight of CRO CRAs and study sites to ensure study procedure conduct is in accordance with the study protocol, SOPs, regulatory requirements, and study plans.
  • Oversee CRO and vendor activities, ensuring performance aligns with study expectations, timelines, budget, and quality standards. May support budget tracking and vendor financial oversight, as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Support cross-functional coordination across Clinical, Regulatory, Data Management, Safety, and other stakeholders to ensure aligned study execution, as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Contribute to, or own the development of, key study documents (e.g., protocols, ICFs, CRFs, monitoring plans, CSRs); under the guidance of the Associate Director, Clinical Operations (or designee) develop operational documents such as vendor specifications, study plans, SIV materials, Investigator Meeting content, and protocol amendments.
  • Ensure inspection readiness and compliance with GCP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements, including timely TMF filing.
  • Participate in study reviews, including data listings, protocol deviation review, TMF quality, and monitoring visit reports; identify trends and drive appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Provide regular, structured study updates to internal stakeholders as directed by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to CTMs, CTMAs, and other junior team members that may be providing study support or regional management.
  • Perform administrative duties in a timely manner as assigned.
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as delegated by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.
  • Contribute to Clinical Operations process improvements and departmental initiatives, as requested by the Associate Director, Clinical Operations.

Required experience & skills:

  • BS or BA in a scientific discipline or an RN (2- or 3-year certificate)
  • At least 6 years of clinical trials/operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry
  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects and timelines
  • Experience as a regional lead (e.g., Europe, Americas, and/or APAC) on a Phase 3 (or large Phase 2) study required; study lead experience required
  • Strong experience with CRO and vendor management, including oversight of performance and deliverables
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate risks and implement mitigation strategies
  • Excellent attention-to-detail, interpersonal and presentation skills are a critical asset; high energy level, personal productivity, creativity and commitment
  • Proven track record of mentoring and developing junior team members through coaching and knowledge-sharing; direct people management experience is a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach.
  • Must be familiar with routine medical/scientific terminology
  • Knowledge of FDA and/or EMEA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCPs governing the conduct of clinical trials
  • Must be familiar with Word, PowerPoint, and Excel (intermediate or higher excel proficiency is a plus)
  • Must be able to participate in departmental or interdepartmental strategic initiatives under general supervision
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and remain comfortable with change and ambiguity
  • Flexible, proactive, and hands-on mindset with a roll-up-your-sleeves, can-do attitude
  • This position is for remote work and may require domestic or international travel up to 25% (as needed); valid travel documents must be obtainable

Base Salary Range: $160,000 - $190,000

This role is also eligible for a competitive total rewards package, which may include an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits offering.

raw.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is looking for a Key Account Manager to support strategic client relationships within the data center and mission-critical infrastructure industries. In this role, you will drive account growth, develop new business opportunities, and serve as a trusted advisor to key clients, including hyperscale, colocation, and AI infrastructure providers.

The ideal candidate brings strong strategic account management experience, a deep understanding of data center infrastructure, and a proven ability to manage complex sales opportunities while delivering exceptional client service.    

You will love this job if… 

  • You are a high performer, self-starter, and love to learn.
  • You take ownership of client relationships and drive measurable business impact.
  • You enjoy building strategic partnerships and identifying growth opportunities.
  • You connect and grow both inside and outside the organization.
  • You like to have fun and be your authentic self.

What you’ll do…

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive revenue growth, customer retention, and market expansion.
  • Build and maintain relationships with executive leadership, procurement, engineering, consultants, and operations teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across hyperscale, colocation, AI infrastructure, and mission-critical markets.
  • Manage complex, multimillion-dollar sales opportunities, including proposals, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Partner with internal engineering, operations, and project teams to ensure successful client delivery and satisfaction.
  • Lead executive-level client meetings, quarterly business reviews, and strategic account discussions.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipelines, revenue forecasts, and account reporting using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive positioning, and client infrastructure expansion plans to identify growth opportunities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, managing escalations and ensuring a seamless client experience.
  • Support customer project reviews, commissioning activities, and acceptance processes as needed.

You should have

  • 5+ years of sales, business development, or strategic account management experience within data centers, HVAC, power infrastructure, mission-critical environments, or industrial equipment.
  • Proven experience managing large strategic accounts and multimillion-dollar sales opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure and complex capital equipment solutions.
  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, developing account strategies, and managing executive-level relationships.
  • Experience with commercial negotiations, contract management, forecasting, and financial performance.
  • Strong communication, presentation, organizational, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across engineering, operations, sales, and project delivery teams.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
  • Ability to travel 30–50% for client meetings, project reviews, and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting hyperscale operators such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Oracle.
  • Experience working with colocation providers, AI infrastructure companies, or mission-critical contractors.
  • Knowledge of data center cooling systems, thermal management solutions, and related infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting complex technical sales cycles, equipment procurement, and large-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Established relationships within the data center and mission-critical infrastructure industries.

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
  • Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
  • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
  • Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado 

  • Competitive compensation 
  • Health insurance 
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote work
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado 

Avicado LLC, was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more.

Avicado's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado, we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us!

raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

The Capture & Proposal Manager is a critical, execution-focused role within the VGOV "Win Center." Reporting directly to the Director of the Win Center, you will partner with Business Development (BD) leaders to operationalize and execute structured capture activities for assigned opportunities and will lead the day-to-day planning and execution of proposal development across our government defense portfolio.

In this role, you will work hand-in-hand with BD teams to operationalize winning strategies, manage the rigorous proposal lifecycle, and ensure every submittal is highly compelling, fully compliant, and delivered on time. This role requires an energetic self-starter who excels at cross-functional coordination, thrives under tight deadlines, and possesses sharp proposal writing and architecture skills.


The day-to-day

Key Responsibilities

  • Capture Execution & Planning: Partner with the assigned BD lead to operationalize and execute structured capture strategies for assigned opportunities, including capture planning, gate readiness, cross-functional coordination, solution maturity, and proposal transition.
  • Proposal Management & Delivery: Direct the end-to-end proposal process, including schedule management, compliance matrix generation, color team reviews, and final assembly of high-quality deliverables.
  • Win Strategy & Profiling: Facilitate win strategy sessions and support development of customer, stakeholder, and competitive profiles to align Viasat capabilities with customer needs and evaluation priorities.
  • Daily Operations & Milestones: Coordinate capture-team activities, milestones, qualifying criteria, and formal gate preparation in partnership with the assigned BD/capture lead.
  • Proposal Content & Writing: Partner with technical and BD teams to draft, review, and standardize high-quality proposal content, ensuring technical architectures are translated into persuasive, compliant solutions.
  • B&P Budget Tracking: Assist in establishing Bid and Proposal (B&P) budgets and meticulously track all expenses associated with ongoing capture efforts.
  • Status Reporting: Maintain robust documentation and provide clear status reporting on pursuit health and proposal progress to Win Center leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Solicitation Analysis: Conduct comprehensive reviews of federal solicitations (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs) to perform requirements analysis and standard/custom solution mapping.

Professional Profile

  • Detail-Oriented Operator: You are an organized self-starter who can multi-task, prioritize assignments under tight timelines, and maintain strict accuracy under pressure.
  • Cross-Functional Facilitator: You are a natural team player who can bridge the gap between technical engineers, business development leads, and corporate leadership to gain stakeholder buy-in.
  • Compliant Thinker: You possess deep operational knowledge of government contracting and exhibit independent judgment in solving complex compliance and editing challenges.

What you'll need

  • Experience: 10+ years leading federal proposal efforts with demonstrated experience supporting capture planning, win strategy, and pre-RFP activities – or equivalent capture experience with strong proposal execution capability.
  • Proposal & Writing Skills: Strong proposal development and technical writing skills, with the ability to edit and format dense material into a unified "voice of the customer" narrative.
  • Collaboration & Drive: Self-starter with a proven ability to collaborate across functional lines, manage internal teams without direct authority, and handle high-pressure environments with professionalism.
  • Software Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of MS Office Suite (specifically Word, Excel, and Visio) and Adobe Acrobat for document creation and control.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 25%
  • Security & Regulations: To conform to US government space technology export regulations, applicants must be a US citizen.

  • Must be able to obtain a United States Top Secret/ SCI Clearance


What will help you on the job

  • Domain Experience: Proposal writing or capture background supporting DoD or federal agency programs in space operations, satellite tracking, or tactical communications.
  • Certifications: APMP (Association of Proposal Management Professionals) certification at the Foundation level or higher.
  • CRM & Publishing Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems and desktop publishing applications, including the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (InDesign, Illustrator).
  • Statement of Work (SoW): Direct experience analyzing or drafting Statements of Work (SoW) and performance work statements.

Salary range

$151,000.00 - $238,000.00 / annually.For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $187,000.00- $281,000.00/ annually



At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Department:Policy

Reports To:Vice President of Policy & Government Affairs

FLSA Status:Exempt

Union Status:Union-represented

Employment Type:Full Time

Location:Remote, flexibility in supporting different time zones will be required

Project End Date: March 31, 2029

Why We’re Here

“No one working full time in the richest country on Earth should have to choose between a doctor’s visit and dinner on the table. But that’s exactly what happens when we treat health care like a luxury instead of a right.” Community Catalyst is seeking Senior Policy Analyst to help shape the national conversation on health justice and elevate the organization’s role as a leading authority on equitable health systems in the United States.

About Community Catalyst

Community Catalyst is the national health justice organization working to ensure care is accessible, affordable, and accountable to the people it serves—and that racial bias does not determine who receives care. For more than two decades, Community Catalyst has partnered with state and community advocates to change systems before harm occurs. The organization integrates policy reform, community organizing, data science, narrative strategy, and thought leadership to advance structural change in health care.

The Opportunity

The Senior Policy Analyst provides leadership, strategic advice, policy analysis, and contributes to the creation of policy resources to translate information to health advocates, providers and policymakers. The Senior Policy Analyst supports issues related to healthcare access and affordability, with a particular focus on eliminating disparities faced by low-income populations and communities of color through power building, advocacy, teaching and learning.

The Senior Policy Analyst works as part of a team to offer policy analysis, strategic insight, and support to state consumer health advocates and grassroots partners. The Senior Policy Analyst will also help lead initiatives to support national and state partners and advocacy coalitions in pursuing their policy advocacy goals.

Responsibilities

  • Track and analyze state-level legislation, regulations, and other policies impacting health coverage and affordability, with a particular focus on Medicaid; synthesize trends across states and identify points of connection to federal policy activity.
  • Build and maintain relationships with state and community-based partners and provide them with policy research and analysis and strategic guidance on how to defend and advance health coverage and affordability across a range of issue areas; adapt resources and information to specific state context and policy environments.
  • Draft comment letters, issue briefs, fact sheets, blogs, and reports on pertinent health policy topics to support the organization, as well as state and national partners.
  • Help craft and implement the organization’s state and federal policy agenda in collaboration with the senior policy staff.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with collaborating national and state organizations, including assisting with development and operationalization of any shared deliverables.
  • Develop sufficient expertise in a number of policy areas that are part of the agenda and the broader Community Catalyst health policy agenda (e.g., medical debt, universal coverage models, health equity, caregiving and aging) to help connect the dots across issue areas for Community Catalyst and state partners.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with other Community Catalyst programs on cross-cutting issues.
  • Support the development of grant and other funding proposals, including tracking of deliverables.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree plus at least 4 years of relevant work experience; or at least 7 years of relevant work experience
  • Broad, diverse knowledge and experience in state or federal health policy, including but not limited to legislative and regulatory issues related to Medicaid coverage, payment reform, health insurance markets, and health workforce.
  • Demonstrated ability to convey complex information in writing and orally so that it is easily understood by various audiences, including health advocacy partners and policymakers.
  • Demonstrated communication skills with ability to provide policy and advocacy coaching, technical assistance and capacity building to advocates in person and on the phone.
  • Experience advocating for local, state or federal policy or systems change.
  • Experience and knowledge of state and federal political processes and their interface with health policy.
  • Demonstrated history of working with a broad range of stakeholders including but not limited to policy advocates, grassroots advocates, community members, and decision makers.
  • An interest in and capacity for translating evidence-based research and knowledge into public policy strategies and practice
  • Organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks at once, respond to tight timelines, pay attention to detail, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated commitment to health equity and racial justice.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to travel in US
  • Experience with state legislative health policy campaigns
  • Expertise in one or more state Medicaid systems
  • Experience working with patient and/or community-based advocacy organizations
  • Experience with public speaking, training, facilitating, and/or coaching
  • Lived experience in one ormore of the health issues listed on the Community Catalyst website
  • Bilingual/bicultural background

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities at this time.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This is a remote, office-based position performed from a home or remote workspace using standard office equipment and technology. Occasional travel may be required based on organizational needs. The role involves extended periods of sitting, regular computer use, and virtual communication. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is $67,440- $84,300based on a full-time schedule. Placement within the range is determined by role scope, relevant experience, skills, geographic considerations, and internal equity. Compensation is reviewed and approved in accordance with Community Catalyst’s compensation framework and organizational policies.

This position is included in a collective bargaining unit represented by a staff union, Community Catalyst United, and specific employment terms are subject to the current Collective Bargaining Agreement.

This position is eligible for Community Catalyst’s employee benefits program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; paid family and medical leave; wellness benefits; and other programs as outlined in the Employee Benefits Guide. Benefit offerings and eligibility may vary based on employment status, role classification, location, and collective bargaining agreements, where applicable. Benefits are governed by plan documents and may be modified from time to time.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Community Catalyst is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may change based on organizational needs, and reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Job Summary

Leads and manages team responsible for medical economics trend analysis activities and cost of care(CoC) initiative development, implementation, and measurement. Extracts and analyzes data from various sources to identify risks and opportunities, improve financial performance, and guide and influence decision-making related to clinical programs and operations.

Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by core values and operating principles that guide every decision we make.

Pie Insurance’s Technology team builds and operates a suite of applications and services that allow direct consumers, partners, and agents to manage commercial insurance policies. The team collaborates closely with our business partners to design and implement new features to help the company scale with increasing demand.

We are seeking highly motivated Backend Engineers who encourage an environment where engineers are thought leaders and foster a culture of diversity and inclusion. Acting as leaders across the organization on design, architecture, and best practices, they elevate those around them and push the company forward.

How You’ll Do It

  • You’ll define and evolve our AWS infrastructure as code using CDK, treating infrastructure with the same review, testing, and release discipline as application code
  • You’ll apply security and compliance practices appropriate to a regulated industry, supporting SOC2 and similar audits; least-privileged IAM, secrets management, and well-defined network and account boundaries.
  • You’ll leverage AI-powered development tools (e.g., Claude Code) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • You’ll participate in peer code reviews across both application and infrastructure changes, ensuring the delivery of high-quality code and adherence to coding standards.
  • You’ll write clean, maintainable, and efficient code primarily in TypeScript (with some C# preferred).
  • You’ll collaborate transparently with product management, designers, stakeholders, and fellow engineers throughout the development process.
  • You’ll help shape the design and architecture of scalable, secure, and robust systems and applications.
  • You’ll deliver software using continuous delivery pipelines, contributing to enhancing and optimizing these pipelines.
  • You’ll assist our support and operations teams by triaging and resolving production issues in a timely manner.
  • You’ll build highly modular and reusable code while adhering to industry standards and best practices.
  • You’ll participate in on-call rotations, consistently seeking opportunities to improve operational stability and system visibility.
  • You’ll continuously learn and stay up-to-date on software engineering best practices and new technologies to improve our systems.

The Right Stuff

  • Consistently demonstrated expertise in AWS technologies, best practices, and architecture.
  • Experienced in leveraging AWS CDK in TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of network topology (VPC, Security Groups, Route53) and IAM access controls.
  • Proficiency using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) as a core part of your development workflow.
  • Consistently demonstrates crafting technical solutions in a variety of greenfield and brownfield projects, exhibiting adaptability, independence, and autonomy.
  • Expertise with CI/CD best practices and experience in continuous integration/delivery using GitHub.
  • Strong expertise in backend and infrastructure software engineering, with expertise in TypeScript (C# experience is a plus).
  • Adopts an Agile mindset focused on delivering small, incremental improvements that provide tangible value to the customer.
  • Embraces a growth mindset, continually seeking opportunities for professional development—expanding technical and non-technical capabilities such as communication, collaboration, and problem-solving—through openness to feedback and proactive learning.
  • Maintains a strong sense of personal accountability, consistently delivering high-quality, secure, and performance-optimized code.

*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
The Clinical Consultant will manage customer accounts to drive adoption and outcomes leading to renewals, expansion and advocacy across account portfolio. This includes facilitating customer outcomes through ongoing analysis of data. This role is ideal for an individual who has a high level of emotional intelligence with a strong project management background. A Clinical Consultant must be dynamic, thriving in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment, with enthusiasm about making a real impact within senior care and healthcare environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Successfully and effectively manage customer accounts to drive adoption of technology, fall prevention culture and fall reduction interventions, leading to contract conversions, renewals, expansions, and high opt-in rates across account portfolio

  • Effectively communicate with various levels of stakeholders within an account serving as the main point of contact between SafelyYou and community locations

  • Support communities throughout pilot period, coordinating and leading weekly fall huddles, discussing opt-in/consent strategies, creating user accounts, performing clinical review of fall events and providing technical platform support

  • Professionally field customer/family questions or concerns to overcome/manage objections to build trust in our service technology

  • Cultivate a confident and engaged community partnership to drive retention and growth by demonstrating value in the technology and expertise in falls management

  • Onsite community support for training, engagement in platform use, and improving fall response outcomes per customer needs

  • Developing and refining customer-facing training materials, answering questions, and troubleshooting technology, serving as the primary conduit for communication of customer suggestions, systems issues and future product growth

  • Collaborate and create various SafelyYou materials to support fall programs for customers and marketing support

  • Effectively conduct zoom training sessions for community marketing/sales departments, family info sessions as well as staff training of system platform

  • Professionally represent SY to the healthcare industry and other business partners through zoom webinars, conferences, and corporate meetings

  • Foster customers/accounts that can further support the growth of SY through shared publications, media content, co-presenting at conferences, or as a business reference (e.g. testimonials, case studies)

  • Represent the voice of the customer to improve our sales process and product roadmap

  • Work cross-functionality with other SY departments: AI, engineering, sales / marketing, implementation, billing and operations to ensure customers needs are met as well as meeting organization goals, and budgets

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree

  • Current licensure as PT, PTA, OT, OTA, LVN, or RN is required

  • Minimum of 5+ years experience as a Customer Success Manager or equivalent in a healthcare setting, preferably in a healthcare SaaS startup environment

  • Experience in senior care healthcare environments communicating with various departments and leadership (Memory care, AL/IL, SNF)

  • Passionate about SafelyYou’s mission and our technology

  • Clinical expertise in falls management, root cause analysis, and interventions

  • A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

  • Ability to present and explain our technology to a wide range of audiences - from C-Suite to clinical to families and non-technical audiences

  • Ownership mentality for our customer’s success throughout the lifecycle of assigned accounts

  • Ability to multitask across accounts, platforms and departments handling fast moving communication and precision follow up

  • Calm and professional demeanor when under high pressure and multiple competing deadlines

  • Exceptional active listening skills and effective communication to ensure stakeholders needs are being met and supporting trust in our technology and outcomes

  • Proactive about anticipating and addressing issues before they arise

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to deliver on multiple projects at a time

  • Demonstrated ability to wear many hats, manage ambiguity, and apply problem-solving skills

  • Team player and willingness to support cross-functionally to ensure customer satisfaction over lifecycle of the account

  • Ability to work remotely in an environment with minimal disruptions to lead/host customer calls via zoom

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, building and maintaining relationships

  • Technology savvy with expertise using G Suite, Office 360, Zoom, HubSpot, Slack and other online platforms

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time

  • Required to provide proof of COVID-19 vaccination

Salary Range:$90,000 - $110,000

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401k Program

  • Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends

  • Non-accrual PTO

  • Growth Potential

  • Company Retreats

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

raw.excerpt: About us At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.
raw.description:
About us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.


What you'll do

The Service Assurance Systems (SAS) Group, part of Global Operations, develop and maintain many software systems and applications which support the operation of Viasat services.

The team collects assurance and operational data from a wide range of systems across the Viasat estate. This data is shared between internal platforms and distributed through Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where it underpins observability and monitoring capabilities that give operations teams real-time insight into service health and performance. To ensure the data is accurate and fit for purpose, the team builds and maintains data pipelines that cleanse, transform and enrich raw data, making it readily consumable by our stakeholders across operations, engineering and management.

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a key role in bridging the gap between software development and operational reliability. You will be responsible for supporting the applications built and maintained by the SAS group, managing deployments, investigating operational issues, and driving the team’s transition toward a modern DevOps culture. You will act as a first point of contact for service issues raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, working to diagnose, triage and resolve incidents efficiently while collaborating closely with developers and operations teams.


The day-to-day

You will be working as part of a small team of developers and operations engineers, supporting the evolution of Viasat’s network and service monitoring capabilities, ensuring it remains world class in support of existing and future services.

Day-to-day the role will involve:

  • Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests and problems raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, ensuring timely and thorough resolution within agreed SLAs.
  • Manage and oversee application deployments across development, staging and production environments, ensuring smooth and reliable release processes.
  • Monitor application and infrastructure health using observability tools such as Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch; proactively identify and respond to anomalies and performance degradation.
  • Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines, working to improve build, test and deployment automation to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
  • Champion and drive the adoption of DevOps practices and culture within the SAS group, working towards greater automation, infrastructure-as-code, and operational maturity.
  • Manage and maintain containerised workloads using Docker, and support the operation of services hosted on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Write and maintain operational scripts (primarily Python) to automate routine tasks, support incident investigations and improve team efficiency.
  • Collaborate with software developers to identify recurring operational issues and feed findings back into the development process to improve application resilience.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date operational documentation including runbooks, deployment guides and incident post-mortems.
  • Provide written and verbal progress updates on open incidents, deployments and operational improvements to the SAS group and wider stakeholders.
  • Support on-call and out-of-hours incident response as required.
  • Liaise with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure system changes are communicated and operationally risk-assessed before deployment.

What you'll need

  • Familiarity with both Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line administration and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrable experience with SQL or data pipeline technologies.
  • Experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Airflow, Apache Flink or Google Dataflow, with a practical understanding of ETL pipeline design and the ability to diagnose issues across data transformation and scheduling workflows.
  • Demonstrable CI/CD experience — building, maintaining and improving pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g. EC2, S3, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch) and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, including Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch, for metrics collection, alerting and dashboarding.
  • Proficiency in scripting with Python for automation, tooling and operational support tasks.
  • Strong communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical issues and their impact to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to provide timely updates on incident progress.
  • Experience using an ITSM/ticketing system (e.g. ServiceNow) for incident management, request fulfilment and problem tracking.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach with strong attention to detail and a commitment to operational excellence.
  • A reasonable understanding and appreciation of IT and security standard methodologies in an operational environment.

What will help you on the job

  • Understanding of TCP/IP networking principles, including the ability to diagnose connectivity issues and interpret network traffic.
  • Familiarity with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, including an understanding of producer/consumer patterns and how message queues are used to move data reliably between systems at scale.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Experience with log aggregation and analysis platforms such as the OTEL Stack or AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience working in an Agile or DevOps team environment.

EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

Leidos QTC Health Services is currently seeking an Associate Director of Facility Compliance on our Clinical Excellence team. In this role you will be an integral member of the Clinical Excellence Team, responsible for driving Leidos QTC compliance with regulations and program requirements tied to the cleanliness, accessibility, and safety of care delivery locations.

The Associate Director of Facility Compliance leads a team of compliance professionals focused on operating an effective compliance program in partnership with VA to ensure facility compliance. This impactful strategic role for Leidos QTC with work with VA Program leadership as well as executive leadership to monitor and ensure compliance. Additionally, the Associate Director will lead efforts to meet regulatory compliance requirements throughout the IPA network to support MDEO.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategy and Standardization

  • Collaborate with VP Clinical Excellence to execute relevant components of the Clinical Excellence strategy and roadmap in support of LQTC’s goals
  • Lead the Compliance team in developing and executing effective compliance strategies designed to meet and exceed VA contractual requirements.
  • Oversee Facility Compliance Managers to ensure consistent adherence to VA contract requirements, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
  • Develop and implement integration strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to enhance organizational value, mitigate risk, improve affordability, and support business growth.
  • Establish standardized processes, procedures, and operational frameworks to ensure consistency, efficiency, and alignment with strategic business objectives.
  • Partner with executive leadership to align compliance initiatives and operational priorities with organizational goals.

Quality Improvement & Performance:

  • Conduct routine compliance monitoring and monthly risk assessments, partnering with the VP to evaluate performance, identify risks, and provide updates on regional initiatives.
    • Develop VA program deliverables related to facility compliance and ensure on-time delivery
  • Perform root cause analysis, gap assessments, business process design, and implement recommendations to resolve issues
  • Proactively address compliance concerns, implement corrective action plans, and coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure timely resolution.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), performance metrics, and supporting technologies to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Analyze relevant operational and compliance data to provide actionable insights, performance trends, and recommendations for executive leadership and program management reporting.
  • Drive short-term and long-term cost efficiencies by identifying and eliminating non-value-added activities, process inconsistencies, and inefficient quality practices.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality, operational effectiveness, and contractual performance.

People Development and Change Management:

  • Direct work by defining clear goals, removing roadblocks, supporting career growth, and reviewing performance
  • Support a culture of ongoing assessment and continuous improvement that promotes an exceptional experience for our customers and our people
  • Develop tools and measures to effectively manage and communicate change to impacted teams and resources
  • Provide leadership, direction, and oversight to Facility Compliance Managers and the broader Compliance team to promote accountability, consistency, and high performance.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and compliance awareness across teams and business functions.
  • Lead cross-functional coordination and change management efforts to support the successful implementation of new processes, technologies, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build strong internal relationships, providing constructive feedback and guidance to management and quality teams to identify opportunities, address challenges, and advance strategic priorities.
  • Support organizational change by promoting employee engagement, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of standardized practices.

Business Development and Customer Engagement

  • Participate in proposal development and readiness reviews/assessments
  • Engage with customers to address issues, drive improvements, and instill confidence in LQTC’s ability and qualifications to execute programs
  • Present briefings, report findings, and share progress in implementation plans to both internal leadership and to customers
  • Manage communications, issue resolution, and ongoing compliance engagement with contract compliance specialists to maintain strong contractual relationships and customer confidence.
  • Collaborate with operations leaders, IT developers, marketing and communications, and sales teams to enhance customer service, strengthen brand awareness, and support business objectives across all business lines.
  • Drive continuous improvements in processes and technologies used to monitor, measure, and enhance customer experiences across multiple channels and touchpoints.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to identify emerging business needs, improve service delivery, and support organizational growth.
  • Leverage customer feedback, compliance insights, and operational performance data to identify opportunities for service enhancements and strategic business development.

Competencies:

  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time or as needed.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication abilities.
  • Customer Data Analysis: Extensive experience in collecting and analyzing customer statistical data.
  • Leadership Experience: Demonstrated success in leading and managing quality and compliance within the healthcare sector.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and informal networks to foster a culture of quality throughout the organization.
  • Team Building: Skill in building and managing teams across a geographically dispersed network.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 10 years or more of leadership experience; or 8 years of leadership experience with a related Masters degree.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience working with VAS
  • 4 years experience managing facility requirements
  • Experience in organizational development, change management, and facilitating teamwork
  • Must be able to successfully pass National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) background investigation

Additional Information: 

  • Travel requirements: Up to 30% travel as per business needs

About Leidos QTC Medical Services, Inc.

Leidos QTC Medical Services, Inc., operating under the brand name Leidos QTC Health Services, collaborates closely with government and non-government customers to address current and future program needs within the health services domain. In coordination with the PCs, we specialize in disability-focused medical examinations, independent medical exams and review services, occupational health services, diagnostic testing, and case management solutions. As innovators, we focus on advancing technologies that improve service delivery, with a particular emphasis on enhancing accessibility for examinees in rural communities. With a proven track record of continuous improvement and steady growth, we now handle over 2 million appointments annually.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. As a result, we offer meaningful and engaging careers to support you and your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

Leidos QTC Health Services is a VEVRAA Federal contractor. Leidos QTC Health Services and each of its affiliated PCs are Equal Opportunity Employers. We have an ongoing commitment to affirmative action and the creation of a workplace free of discrimination, harassment and retaliation. We recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals in all job titles without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, people with disabilities protected under law, and protected veteran status.

Bilingual Full-Cycle Sales Representative

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we are hiring for one of our clients seeking a Bilingual Full-Cycle Sales Representative to join their growing sales team.

This role is ideal for a proven salesperson who knows how to manage a pipeline, conduct consultative sales conversations, handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.

You do not need experience in international moving. The client will provide training on the industry, services, and processes. What matters most is that you already know how to sell.

The ideal candidate is confident taking ownership of opportunities from the initial conversation through quoting, negotiation, follow-up, and close.

Responsibilities

Sales & Lead Management

  • Respond to and engage with new leads through the company's lead management system.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer needs, timelines, destinations, and requirements.
  • Manage opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects and open opportunities.
  • Prioritize leads based on buying intent, customer needs, and revenue potential.

Consultative Selling & Closing

  • Ask effective discovery questions to identify customer needs and buying motivations.
  • Present solutions based on each customer's specific requirements.
  • Prepare and explain quotes clearly and professionally.
  • Handle objections and communicate the value of the company's services.
  • Negotiate appropriately and guide qualified prospects toward a decision.
  • Identify buying signals and use effective closing techniques.
  • Convert qualified opportunities into booked business.

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Take complete ownership of the sales pipeline from lead engagement through close.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, follow-ups, and opportunity stages.
  • Ensure qualified opportunities are consistently followed up with.
  • Keep customer information and sales activity up to date.
  • Manage multiple opportunities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

Client & Internal Coordination

  • Build strong relationships with prospects throughout the sales process.
  • Communicate pricing, services, expectations, and timelines clearly.
  • Coordinate with internal pricing and operations teams when needed.
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and service capabilities.
  • Maintain proactive communication with both customers and internal teams.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • You already know how to sell—you don't need to be taught the fundamentals of sales.
  • You have experience taking prospects through a sales process and closing business.
  • You are confident conducting discovery calls and asking the right questions.
  • You are comfortable handling objections, negotiating, and asking for the sale.
  • You are persistent with follow-up and do not need to be reminded to move opportunities forward.
  • You take ownership of your pipeline and are accountable for your results.
  • You are motivated by performance and commission-based earning potential.
  • You are comfortable working with warm/inbound leads and, ideally, outbound opportunities.
  • You can quickly learn a new industry and become knowledgeable about the product or service.
  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
  • You communicate confidently in both English and Spanish.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of proven sales experience preferred, with strong candidates demonstrating exceptional sales performance considered.
  • Demonstrated experience managing opportunities through the sales process.
  • Proven ability to handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.
  • Strong consultative and needs-based selling skills.
  • Experience using a CRM or sales pipeline management system.
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to work across multiple systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Fluent or professional Spanish.
  • Comfortable working U.S. business hours.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal sales coaching or supervision.

Typical Day

  • Review and prioritize new and existing leads.
  • Conduct discovery calls with prospective customers.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Prepare and follow up on quotes and proposals.
  • Handle objections and negotiate with qualified prospects.
  • Follow up with open opportunities and move them toward a decision.
  • Coordinate with pricing and operations teams when necessary.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Close qualified opportunities and contribute to weekly booking targets.
  • Continuously manage and improve your sales pipeline.

Compensation & Earning Potential

  • Base Salary: Starting around $1,000 USD/month.
  • Commission: Performance-based commission tied to the profitability of booked business.
  • Commission earnings increase based on sales performance and booking volume.
  • Typical production expectations are approximately $5,000–$8,000 in weekly bookings.
  • Strong performers have meaningful opportunity to increase their monthly earnings through commission.

This role is designed for sales professionals who are motivated by performance and want their earning potential to grow alongside their results.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening with Pavago.
  • Client interview.
  • Final selection and onboarding.

Summary

The Senior Solution Consultant provides pre-sales support in the development and presentation of our platform for prospective clients and current customers to address the complex problems that Workiva's platform and solutions solve. This role serves as a trusted advisor supporting the business throughout the sales cycle by connecting customer outcomes to platform capabilities, rapidly iterating on solutions, and guiding customers through technical validation and value-based demonstrations.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute pre-sales framework to engage customers, prospects, and partners via virtual and onsite meetings, drive the discovery process, lead product demonstrations, and identify areas where Workiva solutions align to address customer/prospect needs

  • Demonstrate expertise across all of Workiva’s domain areas - Financial Reporting, GRC, and Sustainability Reporting - developing working knowledge of industries, departments, and use cases where Workiva can have an impact

  • Assist sales in developing account plans in support of Workiva strategies and objectives

  • Conduct process assessments with customers, build Proof of Concepts to validate requirements, build and present partner-specific business cases

  • Ensure customer success by working with implementation partners and Workiva Client Services team for smooth onboarding and long-term success

  • Assist in developing new use-cases or by using existing templates, providing proof of our solution's impact and value proposition

  • May begin to deliver cross-domain coaching, training, or mentoring peers

  • Work with Sales, Product Marketing, Client Services, Scoping, and Customer Success to achieve team and company goals

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience

  • Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of knowledge and related career experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Financial Reporting, GRC, or Sustainability Reporting knowledge is valuable in this role. Candidates should either bring existing expertise or demonstrate strong aptitude and commitment to rapidly developing deep domain expertise in financial services workflows, regulations, and use cases

  • Experience engaging with and presenting to business or IT managers and executives

  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Self-motivated with strong propensity for action, results, and continuous improvement

  • Experience building processes from the ground up, including design, proposal, and cross-functional alignment

  • Demonstrates proactive collaboration and feedback to product management teams to capture new customer requirements and enhancements; may require guidance as needed

  • Ability to solve problems and articulate solutions to business problems with strong communication and presentation skills

  • Hands-on technical experience with SaaS solutions, cloud technologies, and architectures preferred

  • Experience with high-level technical aspects of connectivity and integration (API)

  • Capability to gather business needs and present a value-based, compelling software demonstration is preferred

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 40% Travel

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Workiva is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that great minds think differently. We value diversity of backgrounds, beliefs, and interests, and we recognize diversity as an important source of intellectual thought, varied perspective, and innovation. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, gender identity, race, religion, disability status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

raw.description:
Who are we?
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities, so if you are ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

Role Description

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly consolidated management accounts and coordinate delivery across stakeholders.

  • Analyse profit and loss performance and investigate key variances.

  • Assist with the preparation of statutory financial statements, including group reporting.
