About the Position

At Thryv, we’re a team that lives by teamwork. However, it’s not the work that drives us, it’s the respect, trust, and care for each other that defines us as a team. We’re a diverse community of trendsetters who do our best work in a fun, relaxed environment. Technology never stops evolving and neither do we. We’re always looking for the best and brightest team players to join us.

This role is responsible for leading and developing a team of Campaign Management and National Optimization professionals, building cross-channel digital marketing strategies that align with client objectives and KPIs. Supporting Client Services and New Business teams, this role drives revenue growth and ensures team performance and client service quality meet organizational standards.

Responsibilities

  • Researches clients, their industry, and their objectives to develop well-informed, innovative cross-channel strategic plans, including solutions beyond the client's initial request. Conducts inventory evaluations independently or with vendors and prepares a formal proposal.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally to support the onboarding, launch, and post-fulfillment of custom programs, acting as an additional resource for Campaign Managers throughout the program lifecycle. Proactively shares knowledge and experience with team members.
  • Continually increases knowledge and expertise of the digital marketing ecosystem and its advancements. Shares industry updates with teammates.
  • Supports Sales with new business proposal delivery, coaching reps on new strategies or products and leading as technical and strategic expert on client pitch calls, as needed.
  • Drives operational excellence by identifying efficiency opportunities, keeping proposal materials relevant and competitive, and streamlining end-to-end proposal and onboarding processes.
  • Directly manages and develops a team, including hiring, onboarding, workload distribution, and day-to-day guidance on client and account matters.
  • Sets performance expectations and conducts regular one-on-ones, coaching, and formal performance reviews for direct reports. Identifies development needs and creates growth plans to build team capability and support career pathing.
  • Serves as the escalation point for complex client or campaign issues surfaced by the team, ensuring timely resolution, consistent application of processes, and quality control across campaign performance and client communications.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) or equivalent experience, required
  • Degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • Certifications in Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Google Display (or ability to obtain), preferred.
  • 5+ years of related experience, required.
  • Digital marketing experience including SEM, SEO, websites, listings management, social media, display, etc. required.
  • Experience working with bid management tools such as Acquisto, Skai, or Marin required
  • 7+ years of related experience, preferred.
  • Strong industry knowledge of pay-per-click mechanics, analysis, and reporting, with the ability to work with large, corporate, and national accounts.
  • Proven communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate with and lead peers and cross-functional team members, as well as present to prospects and clients.
  • Developed technical aptitude with the ability to utilize industry related tools and systems (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, Zoom, etc.).
  • Highly skilled in Excel with the ability to compile and sort data via use of pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, HLOOKUPs, macros, conditional formatting, etc.
  • Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to translate client needs into media strategies and tactics and to research data and technology that inform user intent and measure outcomes for ongoing optimization.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills with ability to multi-task, handle follow-up, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • People leadership skills, including the ability to set clear expectations, delegate effectively, identify skill gaps, and hold direct reports accountable for performance, campaign quality, and client outcomes.
  • Ability to travel less than 5% of the time.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must successfully complete pre-employment screening process, as required.
  • Must successfully complete any required training or orientation courses, as needed.

What We Offer

Life requires balance, so we provide benefits around health and wellness, continued education, and work/life balance to help you live your best life when you’re working…and when you’re not.

  • Work from anywhere – Thryv is a Remote First company!
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans, plus a wellness program with added incentives
  • 401(k) savings plan with company match and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuing education benefits with tuition assistance programs
  • One week of paid time off at the end of the year, in addition to our standard paid time off policy.

Who We Are

At Thryv, we’re a team fiercely devoted to the success of local businesses. We’ve been around for over 100 years, always with one goal in mind — helping small businesses compete, win, and succeed. We provide the technology, software and local business automation tools small business owners need to better manage their time, communicate with clients, and get paid, so they can take control of their business and be more successful.

We support businesses across the U.S. and our team members are located across the country, and internationally. We operate as a work from anywhere company and believe this allows us to be more productive.

Culture is vital at Thryv because it shapes our identity and, therefore, our measurements for growth. We have an identified set of values that hold all of us accountable paving the way for our company success and our legacy. All of this helps us deliver results for our clients and creates success for our employees. At Thryv, making a positive impact within our team and in our local community is the reason we get out of bed every morning.

Thryv Core Values:

  • Client Devoted – Be humble with a servant mentality. Understand the uniqueness of each interaction while being flexible, knowledgeable, and genuine.
  • Under Promise, Over Deliver – Deliver expectations and exceed them, have accountability, listen, and understand the ask.
  • Act Like You Own the Place – Taking ownership and accountability in your day-to-day decisions empowers you to act like you own the place.
  • Invest in our People – Hire people that are aligned with Thryv’s core values. Provide learning opportunities to enable all of us to adapt, belong, and create a lifelong career.
  • DONE3 – Define what you say (Done), Do what you say (Done), Follow up and ensure completion (Done).
  • Making $$ is a Byproduct of Helping People – Always be devoted to people, act with integrity.
  • Think Long Term, Act with Passion & Integrity – Focus on making every interaction exceptional. Bring enthusiasm and devotion to every act. This includes doing the right thing, even when no one is looking. Think five years out or think for the long play.

Find out more at corporate.thryv.com/careers/

Belonging at Thryv

We believe in a work environment where all individuals are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources, and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. We want our employees to feel a part of something big and we encourage the sharing of ideas and collaboration across the organization.

We strive to ensure our work environment reflects diversity, fairness, and meritocracy. We believe all employees should have the opportunity to perform effectively in their position. We value every employee and the authenticity they bring to their role and to the organization. As a result, our employee policies and internal practices focus on ability and merit as the standards for success.

Requisition Detail and Process

It is not designed to contain a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

The final job level offered may vary based on the applicant’s competencies and qualifications such as experience and education, and other job-related reasons.

Pay Transparency

The base salary for this position is $57,000 to $76,500k USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Thryv is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, without regard to gender, color, race, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any characteristic protected by law. Red Sky is a venture builder. We conceptualize digital companies and bring them to life—but a startup is only as good as its leadership. We are looking for an Executive Recruiter who specializes in identifying, attracting, and closing elite C-level talent (CEO, CTO, CPO, Co-founders) capable of taking a startup from seed stage to global scale. This is a high-impact, highly autonomous role where you act as Red Sky's internal boutique executive search firm. If you understand the fundamental difference between a corporate manager and a startup builder, and have a strong footprint in the investment or tech ecosystem, we want to talk to you.

Your Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Executive Search: Lead confidential, high-stakes recruitment processes for C-level positions across our portfolio, from initial leadership profiling to successful placement and equity negotiation.

  • Ecosystem Networking: Proactively build and nurture an exclusive global network of proven entrepreneurs, seasoned tech executives, digital leaders, and industry advisors.

  • Rigorous Executive Assessment: Conduct deep competency and cultural fit interviews. You must accurately evaluate a candidate’s risk tolerance, entrepreneurial drive, and capacity to lead in high-uncertainty environments.

  • Hands-on Execution: At Red Sky, we don't rely on costly external executive search agencies. You will roll up your sleeves, drive the search strategy yourself, and personally manage the relationship with high-profile candidates.

What We Are Looking For

  • Extensive experience in Executive Search / Headhunting, specifically focusing on C-level, VP, or Founder-level placements within the tech, digital, or SaaS sectors.

  • Venture Capital / Private Equity Exposure: Experience working within or closely alongside VC funds, startup accelerators, or high-growth tech ecosystems is a major advantage.

  • Deep Business Acumen: You understand how startups operate, fundraise, and scale. Terms like ARR, runway, cap table, dilution, and Series A are second nature to you.

  • Masterful Negotiation & Discretion: Exceptional emotional intelligence, diplomacy, and negotiation skills, with a proven ability to close complex executive offers involving equity components.

  • Fluent English: Impeccable command of English and Polish, both spoken and written, suitable for communicating with international investors and high-profile executives.

What We Offer

  • High-Impact Position: You will have a seat at the table, directly influencing who leads our next big spin-off and shaping the future of Red Sky’s portfolio.

  • Elite Networking: Continuous engagement with top-tier business minds, tech innovators, and venture capitalists across Europe and beyond.

  • Premium Compensation: A competitive salary package mapped to your seniority, experience, and the strategic value you bring.

  • True Entrepreneurial Culture: An environment that champions bold ideas, swift decision-making, and complete professional freedom over corporate bureaucracy.

Important Note: This is an open-ended application for our Talent Pipeline. At Red Sky, we are constantly validating new business ideas and launching new ventures. We want to build relationships with exceptional talent ahead of time, so that when a new startup spins off or a new funding round closes, we can fast-track you into active roles. If your profile matches our vision, we will invite you for an introductory call to discuss your career aspirations and future synergy.

Many Taro Chefs don't have a restaurant - they are true food entrepreneurs who sell food directly to foodies. Taro Chefs are passionate about creating healthy, delicious dishes, and many specialize in “micro-cuisines” that aren’t found elsewhere. Taro enables these local chefs to create and grow their business by connecting them to new customers while automating marketing and operations.

Taro was born in Shivangi’s Aunt’s kitchen in Palo Alto where she found a great demand for local, authentic food. Taro became a reality because we have made it our mission to help people find the food that makes them happy. Join us in the food entrepreneurship revolution!

We are looking for a self-motivated Billing Manager to join our rapidly growing team. This position is ideal for individuals without prior experience who are eager to learn and grow in this field.

Who is a Billing Manager?

A Billing Managerin a medical company is responsible for monitoring and ensuring all financial operations related to a patient’s stay in the hospital, including:

  • Entering patient information into the accounting system;
  • Determining the patient’s insurance coverage details;
  • Collecting financial information about the patient (bills, assets, cash flow, etc.);
  • Issuing invoices to insurance companies;
  • Tracking payments and ensuring timely reimbursements.

  Requirementsfor the role:

  • Fluency in both written and spoken Еnglish
  • Experience in a similar position for at least 1 year
  • Ability to check benefits/eligibility over the phone and online (to make sure that there will be a payer before the patient is admitted to the facility)
  • Ability to check authorization status over the phone and online (checking the auth levels; number of days approved, last covered date, etc.)
  • Working with Census (checking the information in the system before sending the claims to the insurance)
  • Checking the claims over the phone and online
  • Working on the case of the patient until the full payment is received (sending the claims for reprocessing in case it’s denied incorrectly, sending corrected claims or appeals)
  • Preparing letters/bills to patients and discussing the balances with the patients over the phone
  • Posting payments into the system
  • Generating the reports/aging to make sure that all the payments were received

Responsibilities:

  • Communication with clients and primary data entry to the application program
  • Oversee and streamline billing and collections processes 
  • Month-end closing of the billing group information 
  • Plan and implement quality assurance for all processes 
  • Special program/billing planning and implementation 

We offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • BCP and Support in Conditions of Limited Electricity
  • Yoga classes
  • Stable income, holidays and days off are bonus days
  • Free English lessons  
  • Workshops  
  • Mentoring Education  
  • Paid Team-Building activities every two months

Team:Head of Medbilling department, Supervisors, CЕО, the HR team, and 50+Medical Billing managers

You will have two 30-minute breaks during your shift, totaling one hour. Our team is committed to meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality services to our clients. Therefore, you must be ready to respond promptly and address queries within 15 minutes to ensure seamless operations and client satisfaction.

Hiring process:PI+ Cognitive testing, HR interview, interview with the Head of the Medbilling department
